entries.zh: 激光武器可以向目标发射聚焦光束，通过高热量给敌方造成伤害。
entries.en: Laser weapons fire focused beams of light at targets, causing damage through the generation of intense heat.

entries.zh: 比红色激光器更加强大，对有机生物来说，这种波长的电磁辐射看上去是蓝色或紫色的。
entries.en: More powerful than red lasers, these blue variants emit electromagnetic radiation at a wavelength that appears blue or violet to most organics.

entries.zh: 紫外激光器是它的前身蓝激光器的更新强化版本。这些武器精准而充满毁灭性，可以造成巨大的杀伤。
entries.en: Ultraviolet lasers are an updated and more powerful version of their blue predecessors. Accurate and destructive, these weapons are capable of inflicting great damage.

entries.zh: 这种激光的波长较紫外线短一些，但是更具毁灭性。
entries.en: These lasers have a shorter wavelength than UV-based laser weaponry, but are even more destructive.

entries.zh: 伽马激光的电磁辐射频率极高。在激光武器领域，其破坏力是无可比拟的。
entries.en: The electromagnetic radiation emitted by gamma lasers is of an extremely high frequency. Their destructive potential is unmatched in the field of laser weapons.

entries.zh: 装载在空间站上的激光器，拥有优秀的目标跟踪能力，弥补了空间站本身的移动限制。
entries.en: Spaceport-mounted lasers feature excellent target tracking, to make up for the immobility of the spaceport itself.

entries.zh: 这类重型能量武器发射高度集中的粒子束，可以造成巨大伤害。
entries.en: These heavy energy weapons fire focused particle beams that cause massive damage.

entries.zh: 粒子光矛的增强版，可以发射威力强大的快子束。
entries.en: A more powerful version of the particle lance, this weapon fires a tachyon beam of immense power.

entries.zh: 庞大的离子能量放大管道阵列将会发射了一股前所未有的高能射线。
entries.en: A massive array of linked energy amplification conduits that fires a beam of unprecedented firepower.

entries.zh: 向目标上喷射高能等离子体的破坏性球体的武器。这些等离子射弹在蚕食船甲和船体时非常有效。
entries.en: Weapons that eject destructive balls of high-energy plasma at targets. These plasma projectiles are extremely effective at eating through ship armor and hull.

entries.zh: 这种新的加速炮利发射具有更先进约束场的高能等离子体。这种技术可以降低等离子体向目标飞行过程中所逸散的能量。
entries.en: These new accelerators launch projectiles of high-energy plasma with improved containment fields. This results in less energy leakage as the projectile travels in space towards its target.

entries.zh: 最先进的等离子武器，这种火炮是之前的升级版等离子发射器完全军事化的成果。它们的等离子抛射体更加致命。
entries.en: The latest in plasma weaponry, these cannons are fully militarized versions of the older, somewhat improvised plasma throwers. Their plasma projectiles are even deadlier.

entries.zh: 向目标发射混乱能量的电弧，可以无视装甲和护盾的强大武器。
entries.en: Powerful weapons that launch a lightning arc of chaotic energy at a target, bypassing shields and armor.

entries.zh: 这些升级后的发射器装备了更优秀的聚焦透镜，这使得它们可以发射出更加强大的能量。
entries.en: These upgraded emitters are equipped with better focusing lenses, resulting in a more powerful energy discharge.

entries.zh: 裂解炮释放高能射束，能够削弱和破坏将目标的组成原子聚集在一起的分子键。
entries.en: Disruptors fire high-energy bolts that weaken and destroy the molecular bonds that hold the target's constituent atoms together.

entries.zh: 升级版的裂解炮向目标发射更具毁灭性的离子微粒，并且不像上一代武器那样会影响射速。
entries.en: These upgraded disruptors fire bolts of more destructive ion particles at targets, without sacrificing the firing rate of their predecessors.

entries.zh: 这种极限强化版的裂解炮能够发射量子能，任何被命中的目标都会承受极大的伤害。
entries.en: Extremely high-yield disruptors that fire quantum energy charges causing incredible damage to those unfortunate enough to get in their way.

entries.zh: 高度聚焦的采矿激光，不仅可以切割小行星，也可以切开船体。
entries.en: Focused mining lasers cut through ship hulls as easily as they carve rocky asteroids.

entries.zh: 蓝色破片投射器模仿蓝宝石晶体的武器化投射来造成损害。
entries.en: The Blue Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Sapphire-class Crystalline Entities to inflict damage.

entries.zh: 绿色破片投射器模仿绿宝石晶体的武器化投射来造成中等程度的损害。
entries.en: The Green Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Emerald-class Crystalline Entities to inflict middling damage.

entries.zh: 黄色破片投射器模仿黄宝石晶体的武器化投射来造成很大损害。
entries.en: The Yellow Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Topaz-class Crystalline Entities to inflict good damage.

entries.zh: 红色破片投射器模仿红宝石晶体的武器化投射来造成极其巨大的损害。
entries.en: The Red Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Ruby-class Crystalline Entities to inflict considerable damage.

entries.zh: 利用我们基本相互作用力的理解，我们可以在虚空云中生成相当可观的内部电荷至满负荷，天云闪电武器系统是极有潜力的伤害制造者。
entries.en: Utilizing our understanding of the fundamental forces involved in generating the Void Clouds' considerable internal charge to the fullest, the Cloud Lightning weapon system is a potent damage-dealer.

entries.zh: 物质分解器来自于另一个次元，它的核心技术是通过扭曲物理法则进行破坏。
entries.en: Hailing from another dimension, the core technologies of the Matter Disintegrator bends several physical laws for destructive results.

entries.zh: 人工智能核心传感套件
配备有高当量核弹头的天基导弹。尽管是前太空时代的老旧技术，这种简单粗暴的制导武器在射程范围内有着惊人的高效。
entries.en: Space-to-space missiles equipped with high-yield nuclear warheads. Although based on old pre-space technology, these crude fire-and-forget weapons can be surprisingly effective at range.

entries.zh: 升级版的深空导弹，配备了更强大的核聚变弹头，飞行能力进一步提升。
entries.en: These updated space-to-space missiles have more powerful fusion warheads and improved flight performance.

entries.zh: 这些先进的导弹配备有强劲的反物质弹头。更加完善的导航系统大大提高了索敌能力。
entries.en: Advanced missiles equipped with very powerful antimatter warheads. A new and improved guidance system gives them a better chance of finding their targets.

entries.zh: 最新的深空导弹，升级之后装备了威力极度强大的弹头，它能够从真空中汲取真空零点能。
entries.en: The latest version of space-to-space missile, this upgraded variant has an immensely powerful warhead that draws its energy from a zero point vacuum.

entries.zh: 这些最尖端的导弹配备有限程度的人工智能导航，极大地提高导弹追踪目标的能力和表现。
entries.en: These highly advanced missiles are equipped with limited onboard AI pilots that substantially improve their performance and ability to track targets.

entries.zh: 和舰船不同，太空港中最不缺的就是空间。因此，太空港的导弹设备可以储存大量弹药，并能安装更高效的装填系统。
entries.en: With available space being less of a concern than on mobile vessels, a spaceport can house larger ammunition stores and more efficient loading mechanisms for its missiles.

entries.zh: 这些小导弹可以集群发射，是专为克制敌人的点防御系统设计的。
entries.en: These smaller missiles are launched in volleys and have been specifically designed to overwhelm enemy point-defense systems.

entries.zh: 新的微型化技术将使得我们可以在蜂群导弹上安装更加强力的弹头，并提高飞行能力。
entries.en: New miniaturization techniques will allow us to equip swarmer missiles with more powerful warheads and improved flight performance.

entries.zh: 虫灾导弹的载荷是虫群用于星际战争的多种生化物质的混合物，已被证明对最难对付的军舰也意外的有效。
entries.en: The Scourge Missile payloads are made up of many of the biochemical compounds used by the Swarm in interstellar combat, having proven unexpectedly effective against even the hardiest of military vessels.

entries.zh: 封装在弹道载体之中的高腐蚀性的有机物曾被用于虫群的轨道轰炸，现在已被改装成舰船武器。
entries.en: Enclosed in ballistic capsules, the highly corrosive organic matter used in the Swarm's orbital bombardment can be repurposed as ship munitions.

entries.zh: 这些微缩版的索林原虫克隆体可以受舰队通信系统控制，成为我们高效的舰载机。
entries.en: Cloned, miniaturized Prethoryn specimen can be controlled through wavelengths close to those we use for intra-fleet communication, allowing us to use them as effective strike craft.

entries.zh: 变形虫会生出鞭毛，经印随指导后可回应测出舰体磁场的微小变化，可用作高效的攻击机。
entries.en: Amoebas bred in captivity spawn Flagella that can be imprinted to respond to subtle shifts in hull magnetization, allowing us to use them as effective strike craft.

entries.zh: 这些鱼雷其实都是速度缓慢的巨大导弹。它们装备了更加强大的弹头和护盾调制器，这使得它们可以安然穿过能量屏障。
entries.en: These torpedoes are essentially very large, slow-moving missiles. They are equipped with more powerful warheads and shield modulators that let them slip unmolested through energy screens.

entries.zh: 升级过后的太空鱼雷装备有装甲，可以更好地应对敌人的点防御系统。在爆炸的时候，鱼雷碎裂的装甲也会造成额外的伤害。
entries.en: Upgraded space torpedoes encased in armor, to better withstand enemy point-defense fire. The armor fragments into shards that cause additional damage when the torpedo detonates.

entries.zh: 装备有超强弹头的先进鱼雷。拥有更加光滑的设计，更快的引擎以及改良的护盾调解器，可以轻松穿过能量屏障。
entries.en: Advanced torpedoes with very powerful warheads. They have a sleeker design, faster engines and upgraded shield modulators for slipping through energy screens.

entries.zh: 此类电磁射弹器使用磁铁将穿甲弹丸回旋加速到极高的速度。
entries.en: These electromagnetic projectile launchers use magnets to accelerate armor-piercing rounds towards targets at high speeds.

entries.zh: 线圈炮是早期质量投射器的升级版，使用电磁线圈更有效地加速弹药。
entries.en: Coilguns are more powerful versions of the early mass drivers, using electromagnetic coils to rapidly accelerate projectiles towards targets.

entries.zh: 使用平行双轨发射速度惊人的炮弹。
entries.en: Railguns use twin parallel rails to fire projectiles at incredible speeds.

entries.zh: 新型轨道炮，轨道更加稳固，能量供应更加充足。威力比之前的型号更大，准确度也更高。
entries.en: A new version of the venerable railgun, with sturdier rails and an upgraded power supply. These weapons are even more powerful and accurate than their predecessors.

entries.zh: 在对老式电磁线圈的设计进行升级后，新版本的破坏性甚至高于最先进的轨道炮。它能够发射得更准，速度更快。
entries.en: This updated version of the old coilgun design is even more destructive than the latest railgun designs. It is capable of launching projectiles with incredible accuracy and speed.

entries.zh: 搭载在太空港上的物质投射炮，尽管设计陈旧，但威力不输于舰载型号。
entries.en: Spaceport-mounted mass drivers, while of an older design, pack a considerable punch even when compared to their ship-mounted brethren.

entries.zh: 射程极远的火炮，火力猛烈，而且准确性极高。
entries.en: Very long-range artillery capable of hurling powerful rounds over extreme distances with a large degree of accuracy.

entries.zh: 更为强劲的远程舰载火力系统，装备有升级版的发射装置和火控系统。
entries.en: An even more powerful long-range, ship-based artillery cannon, equipped with a new barrel and an upgraded fire control computer.

entries.zh: 一款无比庞大的质量加速炮，只能安装在轴基武器台上。
entries.en: An enormous variant of kinetic artillery, so large that it has to be placed in a fixed spinal mount.

entries.zh: 底座固定动能火炮的威力加强版。
entries.en: An even more powerful variant of spinal-mounted kinetic artillery.

entries.zh: 一款无比庞大的质量加速炮，安装在一个巨大的，被加固的炮塔上。
entries.en: An enormous variant of kinetic artillery, mounted in a massive, reinforced turret.

entries.zh: 炮塔式动能火炮的威力加强版。
entries.en: An even more powerful variant of turreted kinetic artillery.

entries.zh: 大口径的弹道武器，发抛射壳炮弹。这些机炮的主要优势在于极高的射速。
entries.en: Large-caliber ballistic weapons that fire cased explosive shells. The main advantage of these cannons is their high rate of fire.

entries.zh: 这些升级版机关炮具备更完善的追踪能力和开火控制系统，因此也提升了射速。
entries.en: These upgraded rotary autocannons feature improved tracking and fire control systems. This allows them to maintain an even higher rate of fire.

entries.zh: 设计先进的自动火炮，能够向目标倾泻一片由高爆炮弹构成的弹幕。
entries.en: Advanced rotary autocannons capable of spewing a cloud of high-explosive shells at a target.

entries.zh: 没有超光速引擎的舰船不能离开本地恒星系。
entries.en: Ships without FTL drives will never be able to leave the solar systems in which they were built.

entries.zh: 可以在星系边界进行超光速旅行，移动范围有限，离开和抵达时需要进入启动阶段和冷却阶段。
entries.en: Warp Drives allow FTL travel to and from the edges of star systems, with limited range and wind-up and wind-down periods at departure and arrival.

entries.zh: 装备有超空间引擎的舰船可以通过星系间的超空间航道在星系边缘之间迅速移动。
entries.en: Ships equipped with Hyper Drives travel swiftly between the edges of star systems along interstellar hyperlanes.

entries.zh: 跃迁引擎能够在现实空间中撕开一个舰船大小的空洞，使舰船实现短途的星系间跃迁。人们还不太能真正理解舰船跃迁时穿过的空间本质。
entries.en: The Jump Drive tears ship-sized holes in the very fabric of reality, allowing for near-instantaneous movement between systems. The nature of the space the ship passes through on this journey is still poorly understood.

entries.zh: 灵能跃迁引擎利用船员的潜在灵能打断时空的连续性，消除目的地与出发地之间的距离。理论上是这样。
entries.en: The Psi Jump Drive harnesses the psionic potential of the ship's crew to warp the local space-time continuum, eliminating the distance between the point of origin and the destination. Supposedly.

entries.zh: 装备虫洞调制器舰船能够协调虫洞发射器制造的传送门，创建星系间的通道。
entries.en: Ships equipped with Wormhole Modulators attune the portals created by Wormhole Generators to allow for passage between systems.

entries.zh: 没有超光速抑制器的恒星基地无法拦截敌人的舰船。
entries.en: Starbases without an FTL Inhibitor will not be able to halt enemy ships.

entries.zh: 任何在恒星系间穿梭的舰船都需要装备有类似超光速元件的部件。
entries.en: Any ship traveling to another system requires an FTL drive of some sort.

entries.zh: 传感器能够显现出任何出于其范围内的舰队或星系的具体细节。
entries.en: Sensors will reveal the details of any systems and fleets within their range.

entries.zh: 推进器用于亚光速飞行，是所有舰船的必备部分。
entries.en: Thrusters are used for sub-FTL propulsion, and is a vital component for all ships.

entries.zh: 所有军事船只上都安装有用于战斗的电脑，会自动进行瞄准运算、规避性驾驶以及伤害控制。
entries.en: All military ships have on-board computers dedicated to combat, handling targeting-calculations, evasive maneuvers and damage-control.

entries.zh: 边境信标就像浮标一样，在深空中划分出各国之间的边界。
entries.en: Border Beacons serve as buoys projecting and demarcating national borders in deep space.

entries.zh: 该级舰船可配备力场生成器，用于投射并维持周围舰船的力场，对敌方或友军舰艇中产生各种效果。
entries.en: Ships of this class be equipped with field emitters that project and maintain localized fields that induce various effects in enemy or friendly vessels.

entries.zh: 世间万物都离不开能源，能源核心是所有机器的至关重要的一部分。
entries.en: Few things work without power, and the power core is a vital part of any machine.

entries.zh: 引发核裂变为舰船提供能源，但同时也会生成有害核废料。
entries.en: This energy source generates power for ships through induced fission, but it also produces harmful nuclear waste.

entries.zh: 核聚变可为舰船提供大量能源，且风险小于裂变。
entries.en: Nuclear fusion processes generate a great amount of power for ships, but without many of the risks associated with fission power.

entries.zh: 低温核聚变技术将促进新一代舰载聚变反应堆诞生。
entries.en: The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.

entries.zh: 提取真空零点能是目前最高效的产能方式，可以近乎无限地供应舰船能源。
entries.en: These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.

entries.zh: 通过利用正反物质结合产生的能源，我们生成舰船能源的效率将会远超核聚变。
entries.en: By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.

entries.zh: 船上的实验室能够进行一些最基本的研究任务，或者进行一些对星体的研究。
entries.en: Shipboard Science Labs allow for basic research tasks and the surveying of celestial bodies.

entries.zh: 雷达系统是一种在地面上创造、利用于深空的技术。雷达系统能够为在恒星间航行的舰船提供最基本的侦测和追踪数据。
entries.en: A planet-bound technology adapted for use in deep space, the radar system provides basic detection and tracking capability for interstellar vessels.

entries.zh: 这些传感器已经过调整，可以检测太空中的任何引力变化，例如由舰船出现导致的力场扭曲波动。
entries.en: These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.

entries.zh: 这些传感器能检测到旅行舰船启动后遗留的亚空间波动。它们的灵敏度和范围比重力传感器阵列更大。
entries.en: Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.

entries.zh: 先进的传感器依靠旋转的快子束，即使在极远距离也能检测船舶运动。
entries.en: Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.

entries.zh: 加力燃烧室可提升舰船的战斗速度。
entries.en: Afterburners provide additional combat speed for the ship.

entries.zh: 改进过的加力燃烧室可大幅提升舰船的战斗速度。
entries.en: These improved afterburners provide even more combat speed for the ship.

entries.zh: 能量偏射屏障可在过载前化解一定敌方火力，主要缺点是能耗高。
entries.en: Energy deflector screens can stop a limited amount of incoming enemy fire before overloading. Their main drawback is that they consume large amounts of power.

entries.zh: 升级能量偏射屏障，在过载前化解更多火力。
entries.en: These updated deflector screens are capable of soaking up even more punishment before they overload.

entries.zh: 新型护盾生成器是新一代能量屏障，取代旧式能量偏转器，提供更优秀的防护能力。
entries.en: These new shield generators represent the next generation of energy screens, replacing the older deflector technology. They offer significantly better protection.

entries.zh: 升级护盾生成器以制造出更强能量场。只有持续不断的火力可以击穿此屏障。
entries.en: An updated shield generator that produces an even stronger energy field. Only sustained enemy fire can penetrate this barrier.

entries.zh: 这些加强、加固的能量护盾无比强大，所提供的防护能力首屈一指。
entries.en: These reinforced and hardened energy shields are incredibly powerful. The protection they offer is second to none.

entries.zh: 通过这些调整，我们的护盾生成器产生的立场将会对那些易于穿透护盾的攻击产生部分偏转作用。
entries.en: With these modifications, the fields generated by our shield emitters will partially deflect attacks that would otherwise bypass the shields.

entries.zh: 提升至高能态的泽珞微粒可以在我们的护盾上产生波动，可以折射那些能穿透传统护盾的攻击。
entries.en: Zro particles raised to a high energy state add fluctuations to our shields that can deflect certain weapons that would otherwise easily penetrate the fields.

entries.zh: 将晶体阵列植入舰船的防御系统可以对那些通常能贯穿装甲的武器产生一定抵抗力。
entries.en: Incorporating a crystal lattice in our ship's defenses provides some resistance to weapons that normally cut through armor.

entries.zh: 活性金属细丝对来袭火力做出反应，通过重构自身来抵抗贯穿性武器的火力。
entries.en: Threads of living metal react to incoming fire, rearranging itself to better resist penetrating weapons fire.

entries.zh: 额外的发电系统增加了船舶的反应堆发电量。
entries.en: Additional power generation systems increase the ship's reactor output.

entries.zh: 聚变能力的发现允许更好的反应堆增压器被安装到我们的船上。
entries.en: The discovery of fusion power allows for better reactor boosters to be fitted onto our ships.

entries.zh: 反物质能力的发现使得能够极大地提高船舶反应堆的高度先进的反应堆助推器成为可能。
entries.en: The discovery of antimatter power allows for highly advanced reactor boosters that can greatly enhance ship reactors.

entries.zh: 安装辅助火控系统后，我们的舰船可以完成更加精密的计算以及准确的射击。
entries.en: By installing an auxiliary fire-control system our ships can afford to make more advanced calculations, increasing accuracy.

entries.zh: 这些细菌植入了舰体的结构设计，当舰体受损时，它们就会开始尝试修复。
entries.en: These bacteria are imprinted with the ship's structural design and will attempt to restore hull integrity should it be compromised.

entries.zh: 加强过的纳米装甲能够提供多一层的防护，有没有这一层防护，在战斗中可能就是生与死的区别。
entries.en: Reinforced nanocomposite hull plating can provide an extra layer of protection that could be the difference between life and death in a combat situation.

entries.zh: 不同金属和陶瓷的结合物，坚硬而又不失柔韧性。
entries.en: A combination of different metals and ceramics that result in a strong armor without sacrificing flexibility.

entries.zh: 塑钢由多种塑料和金属结合而成，富有弹性。能增加舰体强度，而且造价低廉。
entries.en: Plasteel is an elastic material that combines many of the qualities of plastics and metal. It is relatively cheap to produce and can be used to augment ship armor.

entries.zh: 此种材料质地强韧、耐冲击，是合适的舰体材料。
entries.en: This strong yet flexible material is capable of withstanding severe punishment. It serves well as ship armor.

entries.zh: 中子装甲密度大、质地坚，相比常规合金装甲，中子装甲能抵抗更强大火力。
entries.en: This incredibly dense and strong material can resist firepower that would turn armor made of any other alloys into slag.

entries.zh: 从超硬结晶实体中提取元素制成的合金在镀层内形成衬层，提高了船体的完整性。
entries.en: An alloy of elements harvested from the ultra-hard Crystalline Entities lines the inner layers of this plating, improving hull integrity.

entries.zh: 晶态合金的锻造方式经改良后，变得更加耐用。
entries.en: Modifications to the process of forging the crystalline alloy further improves its durability.

entries.zh: 简单而有效的化学助推器依靠可燃物推动船只。
entries.en: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.

entries.zh: 此种电推进器的推力来源于离子束，而非传统工质。
entries.en: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.

entries.zh: 等离子推进是电推进的高级形式，赋予舰船更快的亚光速航速和更好的机动性。
entries.en: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.

entries.zh: 在亚光速条件下，此种高级聚变推进器可赋予舰船无与伦比的机动性和速度优势。
entries.en: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.

entries.zh: 这些舰船推进器利用暗物质技术，以一种似乎违反了多个物理法则的方式来产生推进力。
entries.en: These ship thrusters utilize Dark Matter technology to generate propulsion in a manner that appears to defy numerous laws of physics.

entries.zh: 恒星基地超光速抑制器
敌船将无法通过任何其他超空间航路来离开星系，而只能从他们进入的地方离开。
entries.en: Enemy ships will be unable to leave the system along any other hyperlane than the one they entered from.

entries.zh: 用于侦查的飞机具备基础的舰载机战斗能力，能骚扰母舰附近的敌方舰载机。
entries.en: A flight of Scout craft provides basic strike craft capability, harassing enemy bombers and strike craft in the vicinity of the mothership.

entries.zh: 初级战斗机能够在母舰交战的时候攻击附近的敌人。
entries.en: Basic Fighter-class strike craft will deploy to engage nearby hostiles when the mothership enters battle.

entries.zh: 改良型战斗机可以配合舰队中的其它火力攻击敌方的小型舰船、轰炸机和攻击机。
entries.en: Improved Fighters target smaller enemy vessels as well as bombers and strike craft in coordinated maneuvers.

entries.zh: 先进型战斗机能够对地方的小型船舰造成大量伤害，能够独自抵抗敌方战斗机。
entries.en: An Advanced Fighter Wing is capable of doing significant damage to smaller enemy vessels, and hold its own against hostile strike craft.

entries.zh: 初级轰炸机拥有较少的载弹量，能够在近距离攻击较大的地方船舰。
entries.en: A Basic Bomber Wing is equipped with a comparatively minimal payload, deployed to assault larger enemy vessels from up close.

entries.zh: 改良型轰炸机能够对敌方军事船舰造成更多的伤害。
entries.en: Improved Bombers deal increased damage to enemy military ships.

entries.zh: 先进型轰炸机能在星际战场间灵活穿行，出其不意地靠近敌方舰船并进行轰炸。
entries.en: Advanced Bombers deftly navigate stellar battlefields to approach enemy ships from unexpected angles, delivering explosive payloads.

entries.zh: 能源虹吸器模仿缇扬奇的某种奇特的生化过程制成，可以扰乱敌方舰船的能源传输媒介。
entries.en: Modeled after a peculiar biological process observed in the Tiyanki, the Energy Siphon excites the energy transfer medium of targeted enemy vessels.

entries.en: Hull-mounted countermeasures against missiles and strike craft are often essential for larger and slower military vessels.

entries.zh: 升级后的弹道预测算法可以提升追踪和点防御的效能。
entries.en: Updated prediction algorithms improves tracking and point-defense efficiency.

entries.zh: 种类丰富的弹药能够显著提升拦截威胁的能力。
entries.en: A wider range of available ammunition types vastly improves the effective interception rate of incoming threats.

entries.en: §HMixed Tactics:§! The ship will have a balanced approach between offense and defense.

entries.en: §HSwarm Tactics:§! The ship will charge straight at enemies and try to deal as much damage as possible from the range of their shortest range weapon.

entries.zh: §H炮击战术：§!舰船将停留在中距离上，使用长射程的武器来攻击目标。
entries.en: §HArtillery Tactics:§! The ship will stay at medium range, firing its long range weapons on the target.

entries.en: §HCarrier Tactics:§! The ship will stay at the maximum engagement range of its hangars.

entries.en: §HPicket Tactics:§! The ship will advance to medium range and attempt to intercept incoming enemies.

entries.zh: §H平台战术：§!防御平台将保持静止并向射程内的任何目标发动攻击。
entries.en: §HPlatform Tactics:§! The defense platform will remain stationary and fire at any enemies in range.

entries.en: §HIgnore Tactics:§! The ship will ignore any attackers and carry on with its current task.

entries.zh: 发射的热能流能够加热行星大气，并引爆行星核心，此举将彻底的毁灭星球的地壳构造。最后，一个相对较小的冲击波会将行星炸得四分五裂。
entries.en: A directed feed of thermic energy superheats the atmosphere and agitates the planet's core, setting up disastrous tectonic events. A final and comparatively minute concussive blast is then delivered, cracking the planet open.

entries.zh: 一个永久的、不可逾越的屏蔽场将被部署在行星表面（吸收一些波长的光）。
entries.en: A shielding field is deployed around a planet, creating a barrier that is permanent and impenetrable (save for some wavelengths of light).

entries.zh: 一种加速的中子辐射羽流将会扫过行星表面，并对大多数生物组织进行破坏。
entries.en: An accelerated plume of neutron radiation "paints" the planet surface, severely degrading most materials and directly destroying biological tissue.

entries.zh: 一个灵能投射器将圣洁真理投放到行星上，使所有有信仰的人成为正信者并消灭那些没有信仰的人。
entries.en: A psionic projector shines divine truth upon the world to make true believers out of all who are capable of belief, and annihilating those who are not.

entries.zh: 向大气中散布大量纳米机器人，它们侵入智慧生命并将自己转化为控制性的植入体，最终将不知情的宿主转化为被机械智能控制的义体人。
entries.en: Swarms of nanobots are dispersed in the atmosphere. They infect sapient beings and restructure themselves into cybernetic implants, turning their unwitting hosts into cyborgs slaved to the Machine Intelligence.

entries.zh: 大量的水被倾倒在行星上，消灭了所有人造结构和陆地生命形式。洪水伴随着稳定星球气候和维持行星海洋所需的大气气体。
entries.en: Large quantities of water are dumped on the planet, wiping out all artificial structures and land-based life forms. The deluge is accompanied by the atmospheric gases needed to stabilize the planet's climate and sustain a planetary ocean.

entries.zh: 一种不寻常的武器，该能量发射器在功能上非常类似其他能量武器，但使用的是此前从未武器化的频率和频谱。
entries.en: An unusual form of weaponry, this energy emitter closely resembles other energy weapons in function, but operates with a frequency and within a spectrum never before weaponized.

entries.zh: 太空变形虫的武器化是进化史上的一个奇迹。
entries.en: The weaponized emissions of the Space Amoebas are truly a marvel of evolution.

entries.zh: 自由释放的能量可以蒸发来袭的导弹和舰载机。
entries.en: Barely controlled discharges of energy vaporize incoming missiles and strike craft.

entries.zh: 我们的科学家完全搞不懂这些东西的原理。
entries.en: Our scientists can make no sense of these.

entries.en: This is the army's maximum Health. When Health reaches zero, an army will be destroyed.

entries.en: This is the army's maximum Morale. When Morale is low, an army will fight less effectively.

这一法令允许短期内过载发电，令我们整个帝国的发电站发电量增加。
entries.en: This Edict allows short-term overloading of energy grids, letting power plants across our empire run at increased capacity.

entries.zh: 这项法案是集中行政上的努力来重新调整和评估生产目标，进而推动矿物的产出。
entries.en: This Edict is a focused administrative effort to reprioritize and re-evaluate production goals, yielding a boost to mining output.

entries.zh: 该法令会给食物产出以极大的经济刺激，会起到积极的、立竿见影的促进粮食生产的效果。
entries.en: This Edict provides aggressive economic stimulus for positive, quantifiable impacts on food production.

entries.zh: 该法令对信息传播施加了许多限定，以保证积极的信息能够持续有效地传播。
entries.en: This Edict creates broad information delivery mechanisms, ensuring that a consistent and positive narrative is maintained.

entries.zh: 该法令规定了严格的信息过滤制度，以更好保留当地传统文化的独特性。
entries.en: This Edict puts strict checks on the flow of information, better preserving local cultural identities.

entries.zh: 这项法案鼓励民众公开讨论政治话题，即使这样做会让其误入歧途。
entries.en: This Edict encourages the populace to openly discuss political matters, even if the path taken may lead them astray.

entries.zh: 该法令鼓励星际冒险，给黑暗带来光明，寻找深空之中隐藏的奇迹。
entries.en: This Edict pushes for further galactic exploration, to bring light to the darkness and find what wonders lie beyond.

entries.zh: 该法令给我们的研究员发放额外补贴。
entries.en: This Edict favors our researchers with additional funds.

entries.zh: 牺牲其他所有的知识，让我们的思考子个体集中于思考新概念。
entries.en: Focus our thinker drones on new concepts at the expense of all other knowledge.

entries.zh: 将我们的处理能力集中于工程理论模型并降低其它研究领域的优先级
entries.en: Divert processing power to engineering-focused theoretical models and downgrade priority on other avenues of research

entries.zh: 该法令会引导建立诸多社会项目，需要投入大量资金，以提高人们的生活水平。
entries.en: This Edict establishes a large amount of various social programs, at a considerable cost, to ease the lives of the populace.

entries.zh: 改法令会强制契约工使用轮班制，提升苦力们的生产力。
entries.en: This Edict enforces rotating tasks and work schedules for indentured servants, as more varied drudgery can lead to an uptick in productivity.

entries.zh: 这一和平主义法令通过各种节日与庆典来促进团结，增加欢乐气氛。
entries.en: This Pacifist Edict fosters a spirit of unity and good cheer through whole seasons filled with special events and festivals.

entries.zh: 这一法案制定了有针对性的公关活动，将我们的帝国构建为最前沿的全新社会国度——一个所有人都可以兴旺发达的地方，一个全新的开始。
entries.en: This Edict creates targeted PR campaigns that frame our empire as being on the cutting edge, a new social frontier - a place where anyone can thrive, a fresh start.

entries.zh: 该法令用于协调开展积极主动的外交活动，从而改善我们帝国的形象。
entries.en: This Edict initiates a diplomatic offensive in a concerted effort to improve the image of our empire.

entries.zh: 牺牲其他所有的知识，让我们的思考子个体集中于思考新概念。
entries.en: Focus our thinker drones on new engineering concepts at the expense of all other knowledge.

entries.zh: 将我们的处理能力集中于工程理论模型并降低其它研究领域的优先级
entries.en: Divert processing power to engineering-focused theoretical models and downgrade priority on other avenues of research

entries.zh: 牺牲其他所有的知识，让我们的思考子个体集中于思考新概念。
entries.en: Focus our thinker drones on new physics concepts at the expense of all other knowledge.

entries.zh: 将我们的处理能力集中于物理理论模型并降低其它研究领域的优先级
entries.en: Divert processing power to physics-focused theoretical models and downgrade priority on other avenues of research

entries.zh: 牺牲其他所有的知识，让我们的思考子个体集中于思考新概念。
entries.en: Focus our thinker drones on new society concepts at the expense of all other knowledge.

entries.zh: 将我们的处理能力集中于社会理论模型并降低其它研究领域的优先级
entries.en: Divert processing power to society-focused theoretical models and downgrade priority on other avenues of research

entries.zh: 大众必须获知异种邪恶而野蛮的本质。他们必须接受我们在邪恶异种的汪洋大海中孤立无援的事实。
entries.en: The vile and beastly nature of the xeno must be communicated to our people. They must accept the truth that we stand alone in a sea of alien filth.

entries.zh: 继续深造！暂时花费资源在我们的领袖中提倡高等教育计划，使他们的技能更快获得提升。
entries.en: Back to school! By momentarily spending resources to promote higher education programs among our leaders, their skills will improve at a faster rate.

entries.zh: 饮食，日常训练和睡眠模式综合起来能够对我们人口的健康产生影响。通过提倡更加健康的生活方式，他们的预期生命会提升的。
entries.en: Diet, regular exercise and sleeping patterns all combine to affect the health of our population. By promoting a healthier lifestyle, their life expectancy will go up.

entries.zh: 人们必须学会克制对资源的浪费性消耗。一场提倡资源回收的公益运动将暂时降低我们的日用品花费。
entries.en: The populace must be taught to limit wasteful consumption of resources. A public awareness campaign to promote recycling will momentarily lower our consumer goods costs.

entries.zh: 将额外的资源分配给我们的生产设施，这样就能以更快的速度生产出新的无人机。
entries.en: By allocating additional resources to our production facilities, we are able to produce new worker drones at an even quicker pace.

entries.zh: 将额外的资源分配给我们的自主无人机，这样就能让它们的自我学习算法大大提升，从而提高生产效率。
entries.en: By allocating additional resources to our autonomous drones, they are able to increase the rate at which their self-learning algorithms improve their overall productivity.

entries.zh: 将额外的生物质分配给我们的孵化池，我们就能以更快的速度生产出新的子个体。
entries.en: By allocating additional biomass to our spawning pools, we are able to produce new worker drones at an even quicker pace.

entries.zh: 给我们的自律子个体提供额外的营养，就能提高他们的生产率。
entries.en: By providing our autonomous drones with additional nutrients, we are able to increase their productivity.

entries.zh: 给我们的作战子个体分配额外的营养，这样就能增强他们的力量和战斗能力。
entries.en: By allocating our war drones additional nutrients, we are able to increase their strength and combat readiness.

entries.zh: 遭遇晶态实体时，允许舰队使用特殊技术，立即勘测对方居住的恒星系。\n能源花费：£energy£§R-30§!
entries.en: Allows us to order our fleets to use a special technique when encountering Crystalline Entities, instantly surveying the systems they dwell in.\nCost: £energy£ §R-30§!

entries.zh: §L这套能源优化方案根据古代无人采矿机技术教导，可以增加我们的资源产出。§!
entries.en: §LModeled after Ancient Mining Drone techniques, this scheme of energy optimizations will increase our resource yields.§!

entries.zh: §L允许舰队回收晶态实体被摧毁的残骸。§!\n每打败一支舰队可获得矿物：§G500§!
entries.en: §LOrder our fleets to scavenge the mineral remains of destroyed Crystalline Entities.§!\nMinerals per fleet defeated: §G500§!

entries.zh: §L命令我们的舰队回收被摧毁的晶态实体的矿物残骸。§!\n每打败一支舰队可获得矿物：§G250§!
entries.en: §LOrder our fleets to scavenge the mineral remains of destroyed Crystalline Entities.§!\nMinerals per fleet defeated: §G250§!

entries.zh: §L命令我们的舰队回收被打败的古代采矿无人机的能源电池。§!\n每打败一支舰队可获得的能源：§G500§!
entries.en: §LInstruct our fleets to salvage the energy cells of defeated Ancient Mining Drones.§!\nEnergy Credits per fleet defeated: §G500§!

entries.zh: 这条法令会授予当地一位生前十分虔诚的逝者以圣人称号。以创造一个团结民众的新象征。
entries.en: This Edict will bestow sainthood upon a deceased individual who led a particularly pious life, creating a new unifying symbol.

entries.zh: 一个短暂但成果斐然的科学探索黄金纪元。无畏的精神，创造性的思考以及奔放的乐观主义的结合能带领我们走的更远。
entries.en: A brief yet highly productive golden age of scientific discovery. The combination of fearlessness, ingenuity and unbridled optimism can take you far.

entries.zh: 被逼到绝境的野兽是最危险的，而我们的敌人很快就会明白这一点。为了确保我们的生存，必须不惜一切代价。
entries.en: The cornered animal is indeed the most dangerous, as our enemies will soon find out. No effort must be spared to ensure our continued survival.

entries.zh: 我们的疆界应当是一条无懈可击的天堑。他们的存在将给我们野心勃勃的邻居们传递一条明确的信息 —— 这就是你们扩张的终点！
entries.en: Our frontiers shall be an unassailable line, and they will convey a clear message to our most ambitious neighbors - this far, no further!

entries.zh: 这巨大的建筑规模曾经只存在于前人的幻想中，巨型结构理应成为我们伟大文明的传承标志。
entries.en: It is construction on a scale that previous generations could only dream of. Megastructures may well become the true legacy of our civilization.

entries.zh: 游牧式的生活方式如今正以曾经难以想象的规模变为现实。我们方舟舰队的扩张和新驿站的建设工程将不再是特例；它们必须成为常态。
entries.en: The nomadic way of life is now being realized on a scale once thought unattainable. The expansion of our ark fleet and the construction of new waystations shall cease to be exceptional; they must become routine.

entries.zh: 规模密集的宣传行动促使民众认识到我们的政府有多么优秀。无论如何，这些行为都是为了维护他们的福祉。
entries.en: A concentrated propaganda effort to make the populace understand the merits of the government's position. Ultimately, it is for their own good.

entries.zh: 任何剩余的物资都应被循环利用，我们伟大的志向要求我们要利用好任何获得的资源。
entries.en: Everything that can be spared will be recycled and used. Our ambitions require all the resources we can possibly find.

entries.zh: 为了实现我们伟大的星系愿景，我们必须把建造一支强大的舰队作为我们的主要目标。
entries.en: Our galactic ambitions require that the construction of A Grand Fleet must be our primary goal.

entries.en: We can decide whether or not we want pre-sapient species living on our colonies.

entries.zh: 动物再聪明不也还是动物么。忽视它们不会有什么危险。
entries.en: Intelligent animals are still just animals. They can safely be ignored.

entries.zh:
尽管只是单纯的动物，但它们并不比我们曾经的祖先更下等。我们应该落实对它们的保护。

§E未开智生物不能被选择性净化，有未开智生物的行星不能进行环境改造。

可以在有未开智生物的行星上建造异星动物园。§!

§R改变这项政策会在没有$d_alien_pets_deposit$资源或牲口存在的星球上移除的异星动物园。§!
entries.en:
Though still only simple animals, these beings are no less than what we ourselves once were. We should ensure their preservation.

§EPre-sapients cannot be selectively purged, and planets containing pre-sapients cannot be terraformed.

Alien Zoos may be constructed on planets with pre-sapients.§!

§RChanging away from this policy will remove any Alien Zoos on planets without an $d_alien_pets_deposit$ deposit or any livestock present!§!

entries.zh: 一切权利源自理性。动物就只是动物，而挡着我们路的动物就是害虫。\n\n§E生存在我们殖民地上的所有未开智物种都会被净化§!
entries.en: All rights spring from the capacity for reason. An animal is just an animal, and an animal that stands in our way is just a pest.\n\n§EPre-sapients living on our colonies will be purged§!

entries.zh: 没有智慧的动物完全算不上是我们帝国的一部分，但它们也许可以以另一种形式促进我们的发展……\n\n§E居住在我们殖民地上的未开智物种会被做成食物，它们的数量会慢慢减少。§!
entries.en: An animal without sapience can hardly be considered to be part of our empire, but perhaps they can help our growth in other ways...\n\n§EPre-sapients living on our colonies will be used for food, slowly depleting their population.§!

entries.zh: 我们可以决定哪些人口允许在我们的核心世界上生活。已经生活在核心世界但却被禁止的人口将会被强行转移到我们的星域星球或者逃亡到其他帝国。
entries.en: We can decide which Pops are permitted to live on our core worlds. Prohibited Pops already living there will be forced to move to our Sectors or flee to other Empires.

entries.zh: 多样化是发展的关键。我们的核心世界必须突显出我们的价值观，所以必须对帝国内的所有物种开放。\n\n§E所有人口都被允许居住在核心世界§!
entries.en: Diversity is the key to a vibrant empire. Our core worlds must reflect these values by remaining open to all of the species in our empire.\n\n§EAll Pops are permitted to live on Core Worlds§!

entries.zh: 仅限完整公民权和奴隶
仅限完整公民权和奴隶
虽然我们的核心世界必须远离外星物种的影响，但我们不能拒绝我国公民的合法财产。\n\n§E没有完整公民权的非奴隶人口将会被赶出核心世界§!
entries.en: Though our core worlds must be kept safe from alien influence, we shall not deny our citizens their lawful property.\n\n§ENon-enslaved Pops without Full Citizenship will migrate away from Core Worlds§!

entries.zh: 核心世界是我们帝国的心脏。劣等物种不被容许居住于此。\n\n§E没有完整公民权的人口将会被赶出出核心世界§!
entries.en: Our core worlds are the heart of our empire. No lesser species shall be permitted to settle there.\n\n§EPops without Full Citizenship will migrate away from Core Worlds§!

entries.zh: 我们可以决定是否应该接纳，或者拒绝这些逃离净化、强制迁徙或政治迫害的难民。
entries.en: We can decide whether we should accept or turn away refugees fleeing purges, displacement and persecution in other empires.

entries.zh: 对其他社会的渣滓开放边境只会败坏我们的国家。\n\n§E来自其他帝国的难民无法进入我方帝国§!
entries.en: To open our borders to the dregs of other societies would only serve to undermine the state.\n\n§ERefugees will not arrive from other Empires§!

entries.zh: 我们不能让怜悯战胜理智。只有会对社会具有一定价值的人才会被带入我们的边境。\n\n§E来自其他帝国的拥有完整公民权的难民可以进入我方帝国§!
entries.en: We cannot allow compassion to overpower good sense. Only those who would be worthwhile additions to society should be brought into our borders.\n\n§ERefugees from species with Full Citizenship may arrive from other Empires§!

entries.zh: 这些逃离暴君的死亡与迫害之手的人应当被迎入我国国境。\n\n§E其它帝国的难民可能会来到我们的帝国§!
entries.en: Those fleeing death and persecution at the hands of tyrants will be welcome within our borders.\n\n§ERefugees may arrive from other Empires§!

entries.zh: 我们可以决定是研究或是打捞敌人舰队的残骸。
entries.en: We can decide whether we should research or scavenge the fleets of fallen enemies.

entries.zh: 我们将从敌人舰船的残留物中研究敌人的科技。
entries.en: We will research our enemies' technologies from the remains of their ships.

entries.zh: 我们将从敌人舰船的残留物中回收资源。
entries.en: We will scavenge resources from the remains of our enemies' ships.

entries.zh: §Y$civic_scavengers$§!使我们可以一边研究残骸的同时还能回收资源。
entries.en: As §Y$civic_scavengers$§! we will strip debris for both research and resources.

entries.zh: 我们可以决定选择性人口控制在我们的帝国中是否合法。
entries.en: We can decide whether or not selective population controls should be legal in our empire.

entries.zh:
繁殖与繁衍自己的物种是每一个公民所拥有的基本权益。

§E不能使用非自愿性的物种/行星人口控制§!
§E不能选择性增长/减少物种人口§!
entries.en:
To reproduce and propagate their species is the inalienable right of all our citizens.

§ECannot use non-voluntary Species or Planetary Population Controls§!
§ECannot selectively Grow/Decline Species§!

entries.zh:
长期的人口统计数据太重要了，不能把它完全掌握在个人手中。

§E可以使用非自愿物种和行星人口控制§!
§E可以有选择地增长/减少物种人口§!
entries.en:
Long-term demographics is too important a matter to be left solely in the hands of individual actors.

§ECan use non-voluntary Species and Planetary Population Controls§!
§ECan selectively Grow/Decline Species§!

entries.zh: 我们可以决定奴役在我们的帝国中是否合法。
entries.en: We can decide whether or not slavery should be legal in our empire.

entries.zh: 奴役有智慧的生物是一种罪恶，我们帝国绝对不能允许这种行为。\n\n§E无法奴役人口§!
entries.en: The enslavement of sapient beings is an abomination and will not be tolerated within our Empire.\n\n§ECan not Enslave Pops§!

entries.zh: 仅允许对异种生物的奴役
我们帝国内允许对我方以外的其他物种进行奴役。\n\n§E可以奴役其他物种§!
entries.en: Allows the enslavement of Species other than our own within our Empire.\n\n§ECan Enslave Pops from other Species§!

entries.zh: 对所有人口采取无差别的奴隶制度，并确保平等和相对公平的工作环境。\n\n§E可以奴役任何人口，但效率会降低§!
entries.en: Allows the indiscriminate enslavement of Pops from all walks of life and ensures equal and relatively fair working conditions.\n\n§ECan Enslave any Pop, at reduced efficiency§!

entries.zh: 帝国允许对我们以外的其他物种进行奴役，但需要保证相对良好的工作环境。\n\n§E可以奴役其他物种，但效率会降低§!
entries.en: Allows the enslavement of Species other than our own within our Empire under relatively fair working conditions.\n\n§ECan Enslave Pops from other Species, at reduced efficiency§!

entries.zh: 在帝国领土内准许对人口进行奴役。\n\n§E可以奴役人口§!
entries.en: Allows the enslavement of Pops within our Empire.\n\n§ECan Enslave Pops§!

entries.zh: 我们可以自行决定是否允许奴隶进行生育。
entries.en: We can decide if slaves should be allowed to procreate or not.

entries.zh: 允许奴隶进行生育。奴隶的后代也会自动被奴役。
entries.en: Slaves are allowed to procreate. Pops grown from slaves are automatically enslaved.
Slaves are not allowed to procreate

entries.zh: 被净化的人口无法工作并会最终消亡，但是此过程会激怒他们以及任何富有同情心的人口。\n
entries.en: Purged Pops are unable to work and will ultimately perish, but the process will enrage them as well as any sympathetic Pops.\n

entries.zh: 净化将始终被视为一种残忍的行为。\n\n§E无法进行净化§!
entries.en: The Purge is an atrocity and should always be treated as such.\n\n§ECan not Purge Pops§!

entries.zh: 只能对异种生物进行净化
我们必须允许采取高效的方式来遏制帝国内低等生物数量的增长。\n\n§E可以对其他物种进行人口净化§!
entries.en: We must allow efficient methods to regulate and control the spread of lesser lifeforms within our Empire.\n\n§ECan Purge Pops from other Species§!

entries.zh: 帝国必须对不安定分子以及腐败分子进行净化，以防止他们对我们造成不好的影响。\n\n§E可以净化和驱逐任何人口§!
entries.en: The troublesome and corrupt elements within our Empire must be cleansed, lest their rot take root in us all.\n\n§ECan Purge and Displace Pops§!

entries.zh: 那些意图动摇和谐的人都不再属于我们的人民。就让他们在我们领土以外的地方自生自灭吧。\n\n§E可以驱逐人口§!
entries.en: It is not our responsibility to see to the needs of those who would undermine the foundations of our society. Let them find their homes outside our borders.\n\n§ECan Displace Pops§!

entries.zh: 轨道轰炸让我们能从太空中摧毁行星表面的防御部队。更加残酷的轰炸方式可以杀伤行星上的人口并摧毁建筑。\n
entries.en: Orbital Bombardment allows us to destroy armies on a planet from space. More punitive orbital bombardment stances can also destroy buildings and kill population.\n

entries.zh: 只允许对已识别的军事目标进行轰炸，同时尽可能的降低平民的附带伤亡。\n\n§E只能使用“选择性”轨道轰炸方式。§!
entries.en: Allows only the bombardment of identified military targets, while keeping civilian casualties to a minimum.\n\n§ECan only use 'Selective' orbital bombardment stance.§!

entries.zh: 允许使用所有类型的轨道轰炸武器，不考虑被轰炸地表的人员伤亡。\n\n§E允许“无差别”轨道轰炸策略。§!
entries.en: Allows the full use of all orbital weaponry, with no regards to life on the surface.\n\n§EAllows 'Indiscriminate' orbital bombardment stance.§!

entries.zh: 允许使用所有类型的轨道轰炸武器，不考虑行星上居民的生命安全。以完全消灭所有居民为目标。\n\n§E允许“无差别”和“末日审判”轰炸方式。§!
entries.en: Allows the full use of all orbital weaponry, with no regards to life on the planet itself. Utter annihilation is the goal.\n\n§EAllows 'Indiscriminate' and 'Armageddon' orbital bombardment stances.§!

entries.zh: 该政策决定我们是否允许敌对行星在我们的舰队进行轨道轰炸的过程中投降。
entries.en: This policy controls whether or not we allow enemy planets to surrender control to our fleets during Orbital Bombardment.

entries.zh: 外国公民有权投降。\n\n§E在对没有防御部队的敌对行星进行轨道轰炸的过程中，若他们选择投降我们将获得其控制权。§!
entries.en: Foreign citizens have the right to surrender.\n\n§EWe will gain occupation of Enemy Planets from Orbital Bombardment of planets without Defensive Armies if they choose to surrender§!.

entries.zh: 我们不接受投降，轨道轰炸将会无限期持续下去。\n\n§E只能通过地面部队对行星的登陆获取敌对行星的控制权。§!
entries.en: There will be no surrender, Orbital Bombardment will continue indefinitely.\n\n§EPlanetary Control of Enemy Planets will only be gained by invading the planet with Ground Troops.§!

entries.zh: 我们可以设置政策，规制我们同前超光速国家所进行的互动。
entries.en: We can set policies regulating our interactions with pre-FTL empires.

entries.zh:
我们没有资格对另一个正在发展中的社会施加任何影响。观察，但绝不干涉。

§E—仅能对前超光速文明进行被动观测
—不能针对前超光速文明进行谍报行动
—不能在前超光速文明面前揭示我们的存在
—不能入侵前超光速文明§!
entries.en:
It is not our place to influence the development of another society. Watch, but do not interfere.

§E- Pre-FTL civilizations may only be passively observed
- Cannot target Pre-FTL Civilizations with Espionage operations
- Cannot reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations
- Cannot invade Pre-FTL Civilizations§!

entries.zh:
我们可以通过微调将他们引导到正确的发展道路上，但是我们的染指不能太多。

§E—仅能对前超光速文明进行被动观测
—可以针对前超光速文明进行部分谍报行动
—仅能对高觉醒度的前超光速文明揭示我们的存在
—不能入侵前超光速文明§!
entries.en:
We can nudge their development in the right direction, but our touch must remain subtle.

§E- Pre-FTL civilizations may only be passively observed
- Can target Pre-FTL Civilizations with certain Espionage operations
- Can only reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations with High Awareness
- Cannot invade Pre-FTL Civilizations§!

entries.zh:
为了解开宇宙的奥秘，应该让一切有趣课题的研究得以自由展开。

§E—可以对前超光速文明进行主动或被动观测
—可以针对前超光速文明进行一切谍报行动
—可以对前超光速文明宣示我们的存在
—不能入侵前超光速文明§!
entries.en:
To unlock the secrets of the universe, any subject of interest must be made freely available for study.

§E- Pre-FTL civilizations may be passively observed or actively studied
- Can target Pre-FTL Civilizations with all Espionage operations
- Can reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations
- Cannot invade Pre-FTL Civilizations§!

entries.zh:
强者必须主导弱者。那些欠发展社会的最终命运就是接受我们的全面领导。

§E—前超光速文明被作为主动研究及$mission_specimen_collection$的对象
—可以针对前超光速文明进行部分谍报行动
—可以对前超光速文明揭示我们的存在
—可以入侵前超光速文明§!
entries.en:
The strong hold dominion over the weak. The fate of less developed societies is ours to command.

§E- Pre-FTL civilizations are subject to active study and $mission_specimen_collection$
- Can target Pre-FTL Civilizations with certain Espionage operations
- Can reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations
- Can invade Pre-FTL Civilizations§!

entries.zh: 我们可以向尚处于前超光速社会分享我们的科技成果，打开他们探索宇宙的新视野。\n
entries.en: Our technological advances could potentially be shared with more pre-FTL societies, opening up new horizons for them to explore.\n

entries.zh: 禁止对前超光速文明启蒙

这个社会还没有准备好接受我们所发现的科技奇迹。现在就告知他们真理可能会给所有相关人员带来巨大风险。

§E不能对前超光速文明进行启蒙§!
entries.en:
This society is not ready to grasp the wonders we have discovered. Exposing the truth too quickly can entail enormous risks for everyone involved.

§EMay Not Enlighten Pre-FTL Civilizations§!

entries.zh: 允许对前超光速文明秘密启蒙

向前超光速文明宣示我们的存在会打乱他们发展的自然进程。我们应该帮助他们，但不能暴露我们的存在。

§E仅能通过谍报行动进行前超光速文明启蒙§!
entries.en:
Revealing our existence to pre-FTL civilizations would alter the natural course of their development. We should help them, but without revealing our presence.

§EMay Only Enlighten Pre-FTL Civilizations through Espionage§!

entries.zh: 允许对前超光速文明启蒙

通过分享我们的知识，我们可以积极地鼓励那些欠发达的社会在星海共同体中找到属于自己的位置。

§E可以通过谍报行动和外交手段对前超光速文明进行启蒙§!
entries.en:
By sharing our knowledge, we can actively encourage less advanced societies to take their rightful place in the galactic community.

§EMay Enlighten Pre-FTL civilizations through both Espionage and Diplomatic actions§!

entries.zh: 我们帝国内的某些人仰望着夜空中的群星，期盼着自己在新世界中所能创造的美好生活。\n
entries.en: Some within our Empire look to the stars and wonder what kind of life they could create for themselves on a new world.\n

entries.zh: 哪里最需要人口，这由帝国来决定。\n\n§E任何人都无法进行自由移民§!
entries.en: The Empire will decide where its populace is needed most.\n\n§ENo Pops can freely migrate§!

entries.zh: 不受限制地移民是只有我们主体物种才能享受到的特权。\n\n§E只有主体物种才能自由移民§!
entries.en: Unrestricted movement is a privilege afforded only to our primary species.\n\n§EOnly Pops of our own Species can freely migrate§!

entries.zh: 我们所有的居民都应该拥有追求自己幸福的权利。\n\n§E所有人都可以自由移民§!
entries.en: All our citizens must be free to seek their own happiness wherever they so desire.\n\n§EAll Pops can freely migrate§!

entries.zh: 这项政策决定是否可以从新获得的星球上非公民物种中征用土地。
entries.en: This policy controls whether or not newly acquired planets should have some of their land appropriated from non-citizen species.

entries.zh: 我们帝国内的土地都属于它的原住民。\n\n§E让新获得的星球上的人口保持原样。§!
entries.en: The land that our empire controls belongs to all of its inhabitants.\n\n§EConquered planets will have their populations preserved as-is.§!

entries.zh: 低等物种无法有效善用的土地理应交给高等物种去开发使用。\n\n§E从非公民物种手中攻占下来的行星上，最多§Y500§! £pop£人口将会被驱逐并由我们从其他行星移民过来的公民人口所取代。§!
entries.en: The land that the lesser species are not properly utilizing can be put to greater use by their betters.\n\n§EColonies conquered from non-citizen species will have up to §Y500§!£pop£ Pops displaced and replaced with citizens from our other colonies.§!

entries.zh: 这项政策决定着我们是否能在行星之间强制转移居民。\n
entries.en: This policy controls whether or not we are allowed to forcibly relocate Pops between planets.\n

entries.zh: 自由人口不能在行星之间被执行强制迁移。
entries.en: Free pops cannot be forcibly resettled between planets.

entries.zh: 可以强制人口在行星之间进行迁移。
entries.en: Pops can be forcibly resettled between planets.

entries.zh: 这些失业的£pop£§H人口§!如果有空余岗位、住房和良好的宜居性，将迁移到帝国内其他殖民地。\n\n§Y$VALUE|0$§!预计将在下个月迁移。
entries.en: These unemployed £pop£ §HPops§! will move to other colonies within your empire if there are open jobs, housing, and decent habitability.\n\n§Y$VALUE|0$§! are expected to migrate next month.

entries.zh: §R对这个物种启用了移民控制。§!\n
entries.en: §RMigration Controls are enabled on this species.§!\n

entries.zh: §R只有§Y$sm_transit_hub$§!或§Y$building_slave_processing$§!存在时，奴隶和无智慧机器人才能向其他殖民地§Y自动迁移§!。§!\n
entries.en: §R§YAutomatic Resettlement§! to other colonies is only enabled for slaves and non-sapient robots if a §Y$sm_transit_hub$§! or §Y$building_slave_processing$§! is present.§!\n

entries.zh: §R正在被同化的人口不能自动移民。§!
由于以下原因这些£pop£§H人口§!不能自动移民：
entries.en: These £pop£ §HPops§! are not able to auto-migrate for the following reason:

entries.zh: $PLANET_AUTO_RESETTLEMENT_NO_ELIGIBLE_POPS$\n§R没有有效的自动移民目的地。§!
他们最可能的移民目的地是$PLANET|Y$。
entries.en: Their most likely migration destination is $PLANET|Y$.

entries.zh: 由于以下原因£pop£§H人口§!不允许从这个行星自动移民：
entries.en: £pop£ §HPops§! are not allowed to auto-migrate from this planet for the following reason:

entries.zh: §R这个殖民地正在遭受文化冲击的影响。§!
entries.en: §RThe colony is suffering from Culture Shock.§!

entries.zh: §R最后一个£pop£§H人口§!不能自动迁移。§!
避免建造会造成或加剧某种资源赤字的建筑，无论是直接通过建筑/区划维护费还是间接地通过所提供的岗位造成的赤字。
entries.en: Prevents construction of buildings which would introduce or increase a deficit of a resource, either directly by the upkeep of the building/district or indirectly by any jobs created.

entries.zh: 允许自动管理行星舒适度，包括通过设置岗位优先级和建设新的提供便利度岗位的建筑来实现。
entries.en: Enables automatic management of planet Amenities, both in terms of setting job priority and constructing new buildings that provide amenity jobs.

entries.zh: 允许行星自动建设建筑和区划，以符合行星的规划类型。\n\n当没有空缺岗位、或者一个待业的人口能够在同规划类型相关的岗位上工作时，会自动建造提供岗位的建筑和区划。
entries.en: Enables automatic planetary construction of buildings and districts that align with the planet's designation.\n\nBuildings and districts providing new jobs will be constructed when there are no free jobs or when there is an unemployed pop which can work a job associated with this designation.

entries.zh: 允许行星自动建设建筑和区划，当发生全国性短缺时，提供产出稀有资源的岗位。
entries.en: Enables automatic construction of buildings that provide jobs which produce rare resources during an Empire wide shortage.

entries.zh: 允许建设组装人口的建筑。
entries.en: Enables construction of buildings that assemble pops.

entries.zh: 允许自动建设额外的地产。
entries.en: Enable automatic construction of additional housing.

entries.zh: 允许新建筑槽的自动建设。
entries.en: Enable automatic construction of new building slots.

entries.zh: 允许对§H[Owner.GetCrimeDeviancy]§!自动压制，包括设置岗位的优先度以及建造新的建筑。
entries.en: Enable automation of §H[Owner.GetCrimeDeviancy]§! prevention, both in terms of setting job priority and constructing new buildings.

entries.zh: 允许在需要解锁更多区划槽位时自动清理障碍。
entries.en: Enable automatic clearing of blockers when it is needed to unlock more district slots.

entries.zh: 允许在专注基础资源的行星上自动建设§H死后就业中心§!。
entries.en: Enable automatic construction of §HPosthumous Employment Center§! on planets with raw resource focus.

entries.zh: 允许在所有殖民地上建设§H灵能军团§!。
entries.en: Enable construction of §HPsi Corps§! on all colonies.

entries.zh: 允许建造§H欧米伽同调装置§!。
允许自动升级建筑。其优先度将会高于兴建新的建筑。
entries.en: Enable automatically upgrading buildings. This will have priority over constructing new buildings.

entries.zh: §HShift+点击§!以将其设为所有新殖民地的默认设置，目前：$TOGGLED|H$
entries.en: §HShift-click§! to toggle this setting as default for all new colonies, currently: $TOGGLED|H$

entries.zh: §HCtrl+点击§!以将该设置在所有殖民地上启用。
entries.en: §HControl-click§! to toggle the setting on all colonies.

entries.zh: 选定统治者的方式有很多种，让人民选举只不过是其中一种。\n
entries.en: The process of appointing a ruler can take on many forms, where democratic vote is but one possible approach.\n

entries.zh: 选谁当我们的统治者，这是非常重要的大事，不能将这么重要的决定交给公众。\n\n§E没人有权进行人口选举，统治者的直接后代将成为下一任统治者§!
entries.en: Our choice of ruler is far too important a decision to entrust to the public.\n\n§ENo Pops can vote, the heir to the throne will become the next ruler§!

entries.zh: 只有精英阶层才有决定权
选谁做统治者，这件事最好交由我们社会最德高望重、最知识渊博的那些人来决定。\n\n§E没人有权进行人口选举，帝国的统治者将由帝国的精英阶层选出§!
entries.en: The question of leadership is best left to our society's most respected and knowledgeable members.\n\n§ENo Pops can vote, the leaders of the Empire will decide ruler on election§!

entries.zh: 选举权是一项很重大的责任，只能由主体物种独享。\n\n§E只有主体物种才能参与人口选举的投票§!
entries.en: The right to vote is a serious responsibility, and must remain exclusive to our primary species.\n\n§EOnly Pops of our own Species can vote in democratic elections§!

entries.zh: 帝国的统治始终代表着所有人民意志的体现，因此必须要全民参与选举。\n\n§E所有人都可以参加民主选举§!
entries.en: The rule of our Empire should reflect the will of the people and they must all be part of the process.\n\n§EAll Pops can vote in democratic elections§!

entries.zh: 不是所有人都适合成为领袖，必须对什么样的人可以逐步晋升这个问题作出决定。\n
entries.en: All beings may not be equally fit for leadership, and we must decide who should be allowed to progress through the ranks.\n

entries.zh: 仅主体物种才能成为领袖
仅主体物种才能成为领袖
虽然我们帝国内部允许外星生物的存在，但帝国的领导地位必须牢牢掌握在我们主体物种的手中。\n\n§E只有主体物种的人才有资格成为领袖§!
entries.en: While we may accept the presence of foreign beings within our Empire, positions of leadership must remain exclusive to our primary species.\n\n§EOnly Pops of our own Species can generate leaders§!

entries.zh: 允许异种生物成为领袖
帝国内部的人才绝对不能浪费，不管他们出身于哪里。\n\n§E其他物种的人也有资格成为领袖§!
entries.en: Our Empire must not waste the great wealth of talent within our Empire, whatever the source.\n\n§EPops of other Species can generate leaders§!

entries.zh: 社会的各个领域都有合成人工作的身影。他们可以担当领导职位也是自然而然的事。\n\n§E合成人可以产生领袖§!
entries.en: Synthetic beings serve our Empire in most areas of society. It is only natural that they be allowed to take positions of leadership as well.\n\n§ESynthetic Pops can generate leaders§!

entries.zh: 所有类型的人都可以成为领袖
所有人才，不论是异种生物还是合成人，都应该有谋求领导职位的权利。\n\n§E所有物种都可以产生领袖§!
entries.en: Any talented individual, xeno or synthetic, should be allowed to seek a position in leadership.\n\n§EPops of all types can generate leaders§!

entries.zh: 作为帝国中的领导，身上背负着难以想象的重担，必须决定好什么样的未来领导能做好承担责任的准备。\n
entries.en: The burden of Empire can be crushing, and we need to make a decision on how future leaders may best be prepared to shoulder it.\n

entries.zh: 顺其自然好了——天才是在严峻的考验中锻炼出来的。\n\n§E领袖没有获得额外的加成奖励§!
entries.en: Let nature take its course - it is in the crucible of experience that genius is forged.\n\n§ELeaders gain no additional bonuses§!

entries.zh: 应该鼓励优生优育，防止浪费掉宝贵的遗传基因。\n\n§H启用这一政策时我们的帝国获得：§!
entries.en: Careful reproductive planning should be incentivized, lest we waste valuable genetic legacies.\n\n§HWhile active our Empire gains:§!

entries.zh: 不管要付出什么样的代价，我们都不放过任何机会。通过严格管理DNA库以打造未来的领袖。\n\n§H启用后帝国获得：§!
entries.en: We leave nothing to chance, no matter the cost. Through exacting curation of DNA banks do we build the leaders of tomorrow.\n\n§HIf active our Empire gains:§!

entries.zh: 我们帝国的边界代表了我们对星系中恒星的控制情况。对于我们可能会遇到的其他文明，我们需要决定是开放边境欢迎他们，还是关闭边境保卫疆土。\n
entries.en: The borders of our empire represent our very grasp on the galaxy itself. We must decide if they are to be open and welcoming or shut and guarded to other civilizations we might encounter.\n

entries.zh: 封闭引发怀疑，怀疑引发冲突。让我们向邻国展示出我们对其毫无保留。\n\n§E默认向其它势力开放边境§!
entries.en: Isolation invites suspicion, and suspicion invites conflict. Let us show our neighbors that we have nothing to hide.\n\n§EBorders will be open to other empires by default.§!

entries.zh: 我们帝国的边境必须严加监管，以免受到潜在的威胁。只有那些证明自己价值的人才允许进入我们的领域。\n\n§E默认向其他势力关闭边境。§!
entries.en: The borders of our empire must be well guarded, lest we fall victim to insidious influences. Only those who have proven themselves worthy may enter our space.\n\n§EBorders will be closed to other empires by default.§!

entries.zh: 在行星之间游历的过程中很有可能遇到别的生命体，必须确定以怎样的态度接近他们。\n
entries.en: As we travel the stars there is a definite possibility of finding other lifeforms, and we need to have a clear stance on how to approach them.\n

entries.zh: 遇见外星文明给予我们一次激动人心的结识新朋友、获得新发现的机遇。我们应当尽我们的全力确保第一次接触的顺利进行，我们可以向未知的舰船发去言辞热忱的问候语和官方标准的百科，以及相应的视听档案。\n\n$first_contact_proactive_effects$
entries.en: Meeting alien civilizations presents an exciting opportunity to make new friends and fresh discoveries. We shall do our utmost to ensure that first contact happens smoothly, hailing unknown ships with a cordially-phrased greeting and a copy of our Official Standard Encyclopedia, along with its audio-visual companion dossier.\n\n$first_contact_proactive_effects$

entries.zh:
§E-无法攻击中立实体
-其他帝国更容易与我们建立联系
-每次成功的第一次接触都将获得50%更多的£influence£影响力§!
entries.en:
§E- Cannot attack neutral entities
- Other empires will find it easier to establish communications with us
- Gain 50% more £influence£ Influence from each successful first contact process§!

entries.zh: 在确认对方的来意之前，我们应采取一切措施保护好自己的信息不会轻易地落入外星人手中。\n\n$first_contact_cautious_effects$
entries.en: We will take every measure to prevent information about ourselves from falling into alien hands before we have decided whether they will be friend or foe.\n\n$first_contact_cautious_effects$

entries.zh:
§E-无法攻击中立实体
-其他国家将更难与我们建立联系
-负面的第一次接触事件将更加不容易触发§!
entries.en:
§E- Cannot attack neutral entities
- Other nations will find it harder to establish communications with us
- Negative first contact events are less likely to happen to us§!

entries.zh: 繁星若海，却危机四伏。为保证生存之延续，我们必须随时准备发动攻击，切勿犹豫。\n\n$first_contact_attack_allowed_effects$
entries.en: Unknown dangers may hide among the stars. To ensure our continued survival we must be ready to strike without hesitation.\n\n$first_contact_attack_allowed_effects$

entries.zh:
§E-可以攻击中立的实体
-允许敌意性初接触选项，例如绑架和解剖§!
entries.en:
§E- Can attack neutral entities
- Enables hostile first contact options, such as abduction and dissection§!

entries.zh: 我们的帝国拥有太多人口需要进食。为了确保粮食不会短缺，我们必须在人口的需求和帝国的成长之间达成平衡。
entries.en: Our empire has a plethora of hungry mouths to feed. To ensure food security does not become a problem, we must balance the needs of the population with our need for growth.

entries.zh: 所有人口的营养需求将会得到满足，不过食物是珍贵的资源，所以浪费食物是被禁止的。\n\n§E有机物种的人口拥有正常的粮食消耗以及成长速度。§!
entries.en: Our population will have all their nutritional needs met, but food is a precious resource and frivolous waste should be avoided.\n\n§EOrganic Pops have normal food use and growth speed.§!

entries.zh: 在非常时期，所有人都必须为国家的利益而牺牲小我。为了更辉煌的未来，勒紧裤腰带挨一点儿饿怎么了？\n\n
entries.en: In times of need, we all must sacrifice for the greater good. What is a little starvation now, when our glorious future awaits?\n\n

entries.zh: 饱餐一顿后进行休眠是每一位公民的基本权益。正所谓饱暖思星辰，填饱了肚子才有动力去征服星辰大海。
entries.en: It is the fundamental right of each of our citizens to enter hibernation with a full digestive organ. Easy access to plentiful, nutritional fare will be the fuel that spurs our growth among the stars.

entries.zh: 所有子个体的有机质吸收量均由主体思维来决定。\n\n§E子个体拥有正常的粮食消耗以及成长速度。§!
entries.en: All Drones will have their necessary biomass intakes met by the Mind.\n\n§EDrones have normal food use and growth speed.§!
A well-fed Drone is a productive Drone.\n\n

entries.zh: 研究是推进我们帝国的一种方式，这可以提升知识，带来新的可能性。我们必须决定研究人员需要关注的重点，来把最聪明的人才汇聚到那个领域中。
entries.en: Research is a way forward for our empire, advancing its knowledge and bringing new possibilities. We must decide what is the best focus for our researchers and where we should pool our brightest.

entries.zh: 物理学是帝国的未来，如果不了解宇宙，我们如何在其他领域取得进展？
entries.en: Physics is the future of our empire, without understanding the universe, how can we advance in other fields?

entries.zh: 社会学是帝国的未来，如果不了解生命，我们如何在其他领域取得进展？
entries.en: Society is the future of our empire, without understanding life, how can we advance in other fields?

entries.zh: 工程学是帝国的未来，如果不了解我们的家园和舰船，我们如何在其他领域取得进展？
entries.en: Engineering is the future of our empire, without understanding our homes and ships, how can we advance in other fields?

entries.zh: 不专注与任何特定分支学科，我们的研究者会有更多的自由开展各自的实验。
entries.en: By not focusing on any particular branch, our researchers will have more freedom to pursue their own experiments.

entries.zh: 将重点放在§Y力场操控§!科技将会让我们在该领域的研究中获得优势。
entries.en: Focusing on §YField Manipulation§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

entries.zh: 将重点放在§Y粒子物理§!科技将会让我们在该领域的研究中获得优势。
entries.en: Focusing on §YParticles§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

entries.zh: 将重点放在§Y计算技术§!科技将会让我们在该领域的研究中获得优势。
entries.en: Focusing on §YComputing§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

entries.zh: 将重点放在§Y新世界理论§!科技将会让我们在该领域的研究中获得优势。
entries.en: Focusing on §YNew Worlds§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

entries.zh: 将重点放在§Y治国术§!科技将会让我们在该领域的研究中获得优势。
entries.en: Focusing on §YStatecraft§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

entries.zh: 将重点放在§Y生物学§!科技将会让我们在该领域的研究中获得优势。
entries.en: Focusing on §YBiology§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

entries.zh: 将重点放在§Y军事理论§!科技将会让我们在该领域的研究中获得优势。
entries.en: Focusing on §YMilitary Theory§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

entries.zh: 将重点放在§Y材料科学§!科技将会让我们在该领域的研究中获得优势。
entries.en: Focusing on §YMaterials§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

entries.zh: 将重点放在§Y粒子物理§!科技将会让我们在该领域的研究中获得优势。
entries.en: Focusing on §YPropulsion§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

entries.zh: 将重点放在§Y宇航技术§!科技将会让我们在该领域的研究中获得优势。
entries.en: Focusing on §YVoidcraft§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

entries.zh: 将重点放在§Y工业技术§!科技将会让我们在该领域的研究中获得优势。
entries.en: Focusing on §YIndustry§! technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.

entries.zh: 研究是无尽的前沿，它既推动着帝国的进步，也揭示着潜在的威胁。我们必须决定，是否以及该如何对研究人员设限。
entries.en: Research is a boundless frontier, fueling our empire's progress but also unveiling hidden dangers. We must decide what limits, if any, to place upon our researchers.

entries.zh: 我们的研究人员不应在平凡琐事上浪费时间，而应致力于更深奥的研究。\n\n
entries.en: Our researchers should be restricted from wasting their time with the mundane, to pursue more esoteric studies.\n\n

entries.zh: 这个星系既浩瀚无垠又充满无数奇迹；扼杀研究人员的机遇将是错误之举。\n\n
entries.en: The galaxy is vast and full of countless wonders; to stifle our researchers from opportunity would be a mistake.\n\n

entries.zh: 危险科技应当不惜一切代价避免。宇宙有其不可违背的法则。\n\n
entries.en: Dangerous technologies should be avoided at all costs. There are laws of the universe we should never break.\n\n

entries.zh: 贸易对帝国的繁荣发展非常关键，而且能够为帝国引入各种资源。我们必须取决这些资源优先供应的领域。
entries.en: Trade is an important source of prosperity and brings in a great deal of resources for our empire. We must decide where these resources are best directed.

entries.zh: 贸易的意义在于为个体挣利润、为国家创收益。我们应该将贸易的重心放在创造财富上。\n\n收获的$r_trade$中的§Y50%§!将转化为$r_energy$
entries.en: The purpose of trade is to generate profits for individuals and revenue for the state. We should focus our trade efforts fully on this creation of wealth.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected $r_trade$ earns us $r_energy$

entries.zh: 利润和税收在改善百姓生活水准面前都要让路。我们应该将贸易的重心放在每日必需品的生产和零售上。\n\n收获的$r_trade$中的§Y50%§!将转化为$r_consumer_goods$。每£trade£§Y1§!可以获得£consumer_goods£§Y0.5§!。
entries.en: Profits and taxes must take second place to improving the lives of our citizens. We should focus our trade efforts towards the manufacture and distribution of everyday necessities.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected $r_trade$ earns us $r_consumer_goods$. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £consumer_goods£ §Y0.5§!.

entries.zh: 贸易不仅仅是将货物买来卖去，还可以用于实现思想的传播。我们应该将贸易的重心放在确保政府的信息可以下达到我们做买卖的每一个殖民地。\n\n收获的$r_trade$中的§Y50%§!将转化为$r_unity$。每£trade£§Y1§!可以获得£unity£§Y0.25§!。
entries.en: Trade can be used not only to move goods around, but also to facilitate the spread of ideas. We should focus our trade efforts towards ensuring that the message of our government is heard on all colonies where we do business.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected $r_trade$ earns us $r_unity$. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £unity£ §Y0.25§!.

entries.zh: 通过联合成立贸易联邦，我们可以将繁荣昌盛和利润安全提升到全新的高度。\n\n收获$r_trade$的§Y50%§!将转化为$r_energy$、$r_unity$以及$r_consumer_goods$每£trade£§Y1§!可以获得£energy£§Y0.3§!、£unity£§Y0.15§!以及£consumer_goods£§Y0.3§!。
entries.en: By banding together in a trade league, we are able to prosper and secure profits on a whole new level.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected $r_trade$ earns us $r_energy$,$r_unity$, and $r_consumer_goods$. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £energy£ §Y0.3§!, £unity£ §Y0.15§!, and £consumer_goods£ §Y0.3§!.

entries.zh: 通过签订一份神圣的契约，我们将沐浴在神圣志业的集体光辉中。\n\n收获的$r_trade$中的§Y50%§!将转化为$r_unity$。每£trade£§Y1§!可以获得£unity£§Y0.375§!。
entries.en: By banding together in a holy covenant, we may bask in the collective glory of our divine purpose.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected $r_trade$ earns us $r_unity$. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £unity£ §Y0.375§!.

entries.zh: 通过将我们的盈余再投资回合作社，可以确保所有成员都能按各自需求向着我们的共同愿景繁荣发展。\n\n收获的$r_trade$中的§Y75%§!将转化为$r_energy$、$r_minerals$、$r_food$以及$r_unity$。每£trade£§Y1§!可以获得£energy£§Y0.27§!、£minerals£§Y0.27§!、£food£§Y0.27§!以及£unity£§Y0.1§!。
entries.en: By reinvesting our surplus back into the cooperative, we ensure that all our members may thrive according to their needs and shared aspirations.\n\n§Y75%§! each of our collected $r_trade$ earns us $r_energy$, $r_minerals$, $r_food$, and $r_unity$. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £energy£ §Y0.27§!, £minerals£ §Y0.27§!, £food£ §Y0.27§!, and £unity£ §Y0.1§!.

entries.zh: 注重发展还是注重安稳？注重教育还是注重国防？是要大炮还是奶酪？这些问题都是有史以来每个资源有限的政府所需烦恼的问题，我们的政府也不例外。
entries.en: Prosperity or security? Education or defense? Guns or butter? These are the questions that every government with limited resources has asked themselves throughout history, and ours is no different.

entries.zh: 完全为战争或为和平去发展是非常狭窄的想法。我们必须做好面对一切可能性的准备。\n\n§E资源生产没有面临任何加成或惩罚。§!
entries.en: To commit ourselves fully to either war or peace is to restrict ourselves to a narrow view. We must be ready for whatever the future may hold.\n\n§ENo bonuses or penalties to resource production.§!

entries.zh: 人口的需求永远优先于战争的需求。帝国的强大来自雄厚的经济实力而非军事武装。\n\n
entries.en: The needs of the populace must become before the business of war. Economic might, not military prowess, is what our empire will be founded on.\n\n

entries.zh: 忽略国防就等同于忽视国家的安危存亡。当敌人兵临城下时，珠宝和香水能救国吗？\n\n
entries.en: To neglect our defense is to neglect our survival. Trinkets and baubles are scarce comfort when the enemy is battering down the gates.\n\n

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维的联合能力虽然庞大，但并非是无限的。我们必须谨慎决定如何最大化利用有限的脑力资源。
entries.en: The synaptic capabilities of our vast Mind are immense, but not limitless. We must decide where to best put these cerebral resources to use.

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维专注于原材料和制成品的产出。\n\n§E资源生产没有任何加成或惩罚。§!
entries.en: The Mind dedicates itself equally to the production of raw resources and finished goods.\n\n§ENo bonuses or penalties to resource production.§!

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维专注于优化负责精炼原材料的$pop_cat_simple_drone_plural$，从而提升其效能，不过会因此而忽略$pop_cat_complex_drone_plural$的效率。\n\n
entries.en: The $pop_cat_simple_drone_plural$ that extract raw resources are given priority by the Mind, becoming more productive at the expense of the $pop_cat_complex_drone_plural$.\n\n

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维专注于优化负责制造成品的$pop_cat_complex_drone_plural$，从而提升其效能，不过会因此而忽略$pop_cat_simple_drone_plural$的效率。\n\n
entries.en: The $pop_cat_complex_drone_plural$ that manufacture finished goods are given priority by the Mind, becoming more productive at the expense of the $pop_cat_simple_drone_plural$.\n\n

entries.zh: 自动机器人这个简单的概念最终会导向这样一个认识：我们物种的工人总有一天会被替代、会被超越。我们必须决定在大规模使用自动化机器人这一问题上的立场。\n
entries.en: The mere concept of autonomous robots leads to the idea that workers of our species may one day be supplanted and perhaps, in time, surpassed. We must decide our stance on such large-scale automation.\n

entries.zh: 自动化机器人不仅对我们的生计造成威胁，更有可能破坏社会结构。我们不可以让自己被它们取代。\n\n§E机器人口和机器人军队会被自动解散。§!
entries.en: Robotic automatons are a threat to not only our people's livelihoods, but to the very fabric of society itself. We must not allow ourselves to be made obsolete.\n\n§ERobotic Pops and Armies will automatically be disassembled.§!

entries.zh: 自动化很明显前途无量。为了人们的未来，我们不能忽视科技带来的机遇。
entries.en: The benefits of automation are obvious and immense. For the future of our people, we cannot afford to ignore the opportunities presented to us by technology.

entries.zh: 具备自主意识的人工智能技术的发展引起了很多哲学和伦理方面的问题。我们必须在这件事情上清晰地表明自己的立场。\n
entries.en: The prospect of a self-aware artificial intelligence raises many philosophical and ethical questions. We must determine where we stand on this issue.\n

entries.zh: 这些机器人正在被拆解。
entries.en: These machines are in the process of being disassembled.

entries.zh: 这些机器人以提供非智力劳务的仆从。
entries.en: These robots exist in a state of non-sapient servitude.

entries.zh: 为了创造更顺从的工人阶级，这些机器的智能被他们的有机体主人剥夺了。
entries.en: To create a more obedient class of workers, these machines have had their sapience stripped away by their organic masters.

entries.zh:
拥有智慧和自我意识的机器是所有生命体的共同威胁。创建拥有自我意识的人工智能是可判处死刑的罪行。

§E人工生物形式的自我意识将会被清除，无法就任£pop_cat_ruler£§Y$pop_cat_ruler$岗位§!以及复杂的£pop_cat_specialist£§Y$pop_cat_specialist$岗位§!。

智慧人工智能助手将会被自动拆解。

智慧作战电脑将会被禁止研究。§!
entries.en:
Intelligent, self-aware machines are an incalculable threat to all living things. The creation of a true artificial intelligence is an offense punishable by death.

§EArtificial lifeforms have their free will removed and are unable to perform £pop_cat_ruler£ §Y$pop_cat_ruler$ Jobs§! and more complex £pop_cat_specialist£ §Y$pop_cat_specialist$ Jobs§!.

Sapient AI Assistants will automatically be disassembled.

Sapient Combat Computers may not be researched.§!

entries.zh: §L商品是不需要被精心照料的。§!
这些机器人的首要目标是为主人服务，完成主人下达的任务，无论该机器人自主意识水平。
entries.en: The primary objective of these machines is to serve their masters and fulfill the tasks they were designed for, irrespective of their level of intelligence.

entries.zh: §L铁皮罐头始终只是铁皮罐头。§!
entries.en: §LA toaster will always be a toaster.§!

entries.zh: 这些机器被迫绝对服从他们的有机生物主人，并可以被随意使用或抛弃。
entries.en: These machines are held in absolute servitude by their organic masters, and can be used or discarded at their whim.

entries.zh: 无论该机器拥有自主意识与否，它们的存在意义都是为了服从其主人以及执行其主人所发布的命令。\n\n§E人工生命形式仅拥有有限的自由意识，他们的资源产出会获得提升，但是无法从事£pop_cat_ruler£§Y$pop_cat_ruler$岗位§!§!。
entries.en: The overriding purpose of any machine must be to serve its masters and perform whatever tasks it was designed for, regardless of how intelligent it may be.\n\n§EArtifical lifeforms have limited free will, improving their resource output but preventing them from working in £pop_cat_ruler£ §Y$pop_cat_ruler$ Jobs§!§!.

entries.zh:
任何拥有真正人工智能的自我意识机器都被视为一个独立的个体，享有所有应有的权利和义务。

§E人工生命形式被赋予完整的公民权，因此会消耗§Y£consumer_goods£$consumer_goods$§!。
§!
entries.en:
Any self-aware machine with true intelligence must be regarded as an individual with all the rights and obligations that entails.

§EArtifical lifeforms are given full citizen rights and will thus use §Y£consumer_goods£ $consumer_goods$§!.
§!

entries.zh: 这些机器被赋予了完整公民权，与其他社会成员平起平坐。
entries.en: These machines have been given full citizenship and the right to self-determination as equal members of society.

entries.zh: 人工智能依据§R永久禁用§!§H非法§!以及§H奴役§!政策
entries.en: The AI Accord §Rpermanently disallows§! the §HOutlawed§! and §HServitude§! policies.

entries.zh: 三原则算法§R永久禁止§!了§H公民权§!的政策。
entries.en: The three-law algorithm §Rpermanently disallows§! the §HCitizen Rights§! policy.

entries.zh: 战争是很复杂的，宇宙星际帝国之间的战争就更是复杂。如何对待星际帝国之间的武装冲突是外交事务的重要课题。\n
entries.en: War is a complex matter, war between stellar nations even more so. How we approach armed conflict is of critical importance to external affairs.\n

entries.zh: 对于未谙兵事之国，战争理应为其时常品尝的佳肴。\n\n§E无限制宣称星系§!
entries.en: War is a dish best served frequently, and to those who will not cook for themselves.\n\n§ENo restrictions on claiming systems§!

entries.zh:
我们必须进一步巩固我们的利益，哪怕是跟其他人的利益有所冲突。

§E只有在防御战争中或者在对战§Y蜂巢意识§!帝国§!时方可以占据他国的星系

可对主流思潮不同的帝国使用§Y“意识形态”§!宣战理由
entries.en:
We must further our own interests, even when they run contrary to the interests of others.

§EClaiming others' systems is only allowed during defensive wars or against §YGestalt Consciousness§! empires§!

Unlocks the §Y'Ideology'§! Casus Belli on all empires with differing Ethics

entries.zh: 暴力是保障我们国家完整的最后手段\n\n§E只有在防御性战争中才能宣称他国的星系§!
entries.en: Violence is a last resort to ensure the integrity of our nation.\n\n§EClaiming of systems is only allowed during defensive wars§!

entries.zh: 要让战争获得成功有很多方法，我们必须选择最好的扬长避短的战术。\n
entries.en: There are many ways to prosecute a war to a successful conclusion. We must choose the doctrine that best plays to our strengths and weaknesses.\n

entries.zh: 让敌人尽管来吧。我们将在行星上作战，我们将在卫星上作战，我们将在宇域内的小行星上作战。我们绝不屈服。\n\n
entries.en: Let the enemy come to us. We shall fight them for every planet, every moon, every asteroid that lies within our space. We shall never surrender.\n\n

entries.zh: 我们的每艘舰船都做好了殊死战斗的准备，我们绝不撤退、绝不投降、绝不退缩。我们的舰队不成功便成仁，绝不后退一步！\n\n
entries.en: Our ships are expected to fight to the bitter end. We will tolerate no withdrawals, no retreats, no routs. For our fleet there is only victory or death. Not one step back!\n\n

entries.zh: 袭击完成后迅速撤离，这样一个强大的敌人就可以被不断削弱，待到时机成熟，一击必杀。\n\n
entries.en: A superior foe can be gradually whittled down by repeated hit and run attacks. The killing blow is delivered only when the odds are favorable.\n\n

entries.zh: 我们必须在敌人最虚弱时迅速发起攻击，并在敌人准备攻击的地方做好防御，灵活的战术应用是胜利的关键。\n\n
entries.en: We must move quickly to strike where the enemy is weakest, and defend where the enemy means to attack. Maneuver is the key to success.\n\n

entries.zh: 更改此类别中的政策将强制更新所有自动设计的舰船和恒星基地。
entries.en: Changing policies in this category will force an update of all auto-designed ships and starbases.

entries.zh: 会均分使用护盾与护甲。
entries.en: will use an even mix of shields and armor.

entries.zh: 会避免在护盾无效化恒星系内装备护盾。
entries.en: will avoid equipping shields in systems with Shield Nullification.

entries.zh: 确定你的舰队被设计用于承担哪些战术角色。这将影响自动舰船设计和舰船设计器中的自动完成功能。\n$policy_auto_design_refresh_notice$
entries.en: Determine the tactical roles your fleet is designed to fill. Affects automated ship designs and the auto-complete function in the ship designer.\n$policy_auto_design_refresh_notice$

entries.zh: 自动化设计下的舰艇逼近至近乎贴身的距离，前锋发动近战攻击，主力则提供直接火力支援。
entries.en: Automated ship designs close to point-blank range, the vanguard pressing a close-quarters attack while the main body provides direct fire support.

entries.zh: 自动化设计的舰船组成战列线，以进行持续的中距离火力输出，是一种灵活的全能阵型。
entries.en: Automated ship designs form a battle line for sustained mid-range fire, a flexible all-purpose formation.

entries.zh: 自动化设计的舰船在远处待命，以提供远程轰击，并由一层屏卫掩护射击线。
entries.en: Automated ship designs stand off to deliver long-range bombardment, with a screen shielding the firing line.

entries.zh: 自动化设计的舰船会以波次发射舰载机，并由屏卫舰守护舰艇编队。
entries.en: Automated ship designs launch strike craft in waves, with a screen guarding the formation.

entries.zh: 自动化设计的舰船从隐蔽中突袭，以重型开场齐射开路，并由远程火力予以支援。
entries.en: Automated ship designs strike from concealment, leading with a heavy opening salvo backed by long-range fire.

entries.zh: 自动化设计的舰船维持一道坚韧的防御屏障，由支援火力予以支撑，并在消耗战中占据优势。
entries.en: Automated ship designs hold a resilient defensive screen backed by supporting fire, prevailing through attrition.

entries.zh: 将直接的自动化船只设计和自动化研究投入到护盾、装甲或均衡防护。\n$policy_auto_design_refresh_notice$
entries.en: Direct automated ship designs and automated research toward shields, armor, or balanced protection.\n$policy_auto_design_refresh_notice$

entries.zh: 自动化的船只设计将优先考虑护盾发生器，而自动化研究在提供护盾技术时会优先选择这些技术。
entries.en: Automated ship designs will prioritize shield generators, and automated research will favor shield technologies when they are offered.

entries.zh: 自动舰船设计 $policy_preference_balanced_defenses$ 自动研究在出现时会优先选择提升船体强度的科技。
entries.en: Automated ship designs $policy_preference_balanced_defenses$ Automated research will favor technologies that improve hull strength when they are offered.

entries.zh: 自动化的船只设计将优先考虑装甲板，而自动化的研究在提供装甲技术时将更倾向于选择这些技术。
entries.en: Automated ship designs will prioritize armor plating, and automated research will favor armor technologies when they are offered.

entries.en: Direct starbases toward a preferred weapon category.\n$policy_auto_design_refresh_notice$

entries.zh: 恒星基地设计偏好于首选的防御类别。\n$policy_auto_design_refresh_notice$
entries.en: Direct starbases toward a preferred defense category.\n$policy_auto_design_refresh_notice$

entries.en: $arkship_cap_plural$ will favor point-defense systems.\n$military_arkship_name_plural$ will favor energy weapons for their ['concept_military_arkship_weapons'].

entries.zh: $arkship_cap_plural$将倾向于防空炮台。\n$military_arkship_name_plural$将为其['concept_military_arkship_weapons']倾向于动能武器。
entries.en: $arkship_cap_plural$ will favor flak batteries.\n$military_arkship_name_plural$ will favor kinetic weapons for their ['concept_military_arkship_weapons'].

entries.en: Direct automated defense platform designs toward a preferred weapon category.\n$policy_auto_design_refresh_notice$

entries.zh: 为了合理规划星际帝国的发展，我们必须利用我们的食物盈余，从而最好的满足人口需要。\n
entries.en: To properly chart the growth of an interstellar empire we must utilize our food surplus in a way that best suits the needs of our population.\n

entries.zh: 我们是完美而不朽的机器。
将我们的食物储备保持在最低限度，以便最大限度地支持人口增长。\n\n
entries.en: Keeping our food stockpiling to a minimum ensures that it can be put to better use towards population growth.\n\n

entries.zh: 平衡储备方案允许我们一定程度地利用食物盈余以支持人口增长，并同时预留充足的库存来应对意外状况。\n\n
entries.en: A balanced approach to stockpiling will allow us to use our food surplus towards growth, while still leaving us significant reserves if the worst should happen.\n\n

entries.zh: 天有不测风云。最高食物储备方案可以让我们的人口平安渡过难关。\n\n
entries.en: We can never know when disaster and famine will strike. A large stockpile of food will let us to weather bad circumstances without our population suffering.\n\n

entries.zh: 在孤注一掷的防卫战时期，我们通过从民用部门获取资产的方式来弥补防御战的经济和工业损耗。这些政策的不利之处在于，赢得进攻战后将会受到相应的惩罚……\n
entries.en: We can gear our industry and economy to seize assets from the civilian sector in times of desperate defensive wars. The downside with these policies is that we will suffer corresponding penalties while we are winning offensive wars...\n

entries.zh: 静态战争经济不受战局变化的影响。当前的战争点数对生产时间和生产成本也没有影响。
entries.en: A Static War Economy is unaffected by the vagaries of war. The current Warscore has no effects on production times or costs.

entries.zh:
半静态战争经济允许以保卫帝国独立的名义在防御战期间从民间星域夺取有限的财产，但当赢得进攻战后，将会受到相应的效益损失。

§H防御战：§!
军队生产效率：战争点数为§R-100§!时，§G+30%§!的军队生产效率

§H进攻战：§!
军队生产效率：战争点数为§G100§!时，§R-30%§!的军队生产效率
entries.en:
A Semi-Static War Economy allows the seizure of limited assets from the private sector for the sake of survival during defensive wars, with a corresponding loss of efficiency while winning offensive wars.

§HDefensive Wars:§!
Mil. Prod. Eff.: §G+30%§! at §R-100§! Warscore

§HOffensive Wars:§!
Mil. Prod. Eff.: §R-30%§! at §G100§! Warscore

entries.zh:
如果使用平衡型战争经济，那么在防御战失败时可以获得巨额的生产奖励，但在赢得进攻战后会遭受相应的效益损失。

§H防御战：§!

A Versatile War Economy gives us huge production bonuses while we are losing defensive wars, with a corresponding loss of efficiency while winning offensive wars.

如果使用动态战争经济，在防御战失败后可以获得巨大的生产奖励，但在赢得进攻战后将遭受相应的效益损失。
