entries.zh: 拥有至少一个£building£§Y$building_fortress$§!建筑的星球将可以抑制敌方的超光速引擎。
entries.en: Planets with at least one £building£ §Y$building_fortress$§! building will be able to inhibit the FTL drives of hostile fleets.

entries.zh: 允许原生物种以外的物种个体成为国家统治者候选人。
entries.en: Allows individuals of Species other than our founding Species to be candidates in our Ruler elections.

entries.zh: 允许对星系中的每一条超平面航道进行详细测绘。
entries.en: Allows detailed mapping of every Hyperlane in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 允许对那些接近智能生物的物种进行基因提升和社会整合。
entries.en: Allows genetically Uplifting and socially integrating Species which are close to being sapient.

entries.zh: 允许和其他帝国进行基本外交
entries.en: Allows basic diplomacy with other Empires.

entries.zh: 允许与其他帝国建立同盟
entries.en: Allows establishing Alliances with other Empires.

entries.zh: 允许强制让其他帝国臣服。
entries.en: Allows forceful subjugation of other Empires.

entries.zh: 允许招募帝国内其他物种的领袖
entries.en: Allows recruitment of Leaders from other Species within our Empire.

entries.zh: 允许和同盟国和附庸国一起创建联邦
entries.en: Allows forming Federations from Alliances and Vassals.

entries.zh: 允许对帝国内物种的基因特质进行修改
entries.en: Allows us to actively modify the genetic Traits of a Species within our Empire.

entries.zh: 允许我们移除物种的有益特质，增加不利特质，并在修正的同时更改他们的外观。
entries.en: Allows us to remove beneficial Traits, add detrimental Traits, and alter Pop appearance when modifying a species.

entries.zh: 允许我们通过基因修饰的手段更改物种的适性星球种类。
entries.en: Allows us to change the preferred planet type of a species through genetic modification.

entries.zh: 解锁更多在改造某个物种时可以添加的特质。
entries.en: Unlocks additional Traits that we can add to Species when modifying them.

entries.zh: 允许建造用于在行星殖民的殖民船
entries.en: Enables the construction of Colony Ships which can be used to colonize planets

entries.zh: 允许建造由私人星域的不明人士资助的私人殖民船。如此，殖民者的思潮可能和主流不同。
entries.en: Allows the construction of Private Colony Ships funded by unknown actors from the private sector. As a result the colonists may have ethics differing from the majority.

entries.zh: 允许行星建立行星项目生产能量币
entries.en: Allows planets to produce Energy Credits as a planetary project.

entries.zh: 待业的自由人作为个体企业生产能量币。
entries.en: Free unemployed Pops produce Energy Credits as a result of individual enterprises.

entries.zh: 允许工程船建造虫洞站。
entries.en: Enables Construction Ships to build Wormhole Stations.

entries.zh: 增加虫洞的舰队容量上限和范围，同时减少生成时间
entries.en: Increases Wormhole fleet-capacity limit and range while reducing generation-time.

entries.zh: 允许任意规模的舰队通过虫洞。如果舰队超出了虫洞的舰队容量，那么虫洞会在转移后崩塌，新虫洞的再生时间，根据虫洞的舰队超额量相应增加。
entries.en: Allows any fleet-size to pass through the Wormhole. If the fleet is larger than the Wormhole fleet-capacity, the Wormhole will collapse after transfer and the time required for producing another Wormhole is increased relative to the Wormhole's fleet-capacity overreach.

entries.zh: 允许科研船在没有科学官的情况下调查行星。
entries.en: Allows Science Ships to survey planets without a Scientist on board.

entries.zh: 由拥有机器人特质的物种组成的军队同时会获得机械特质。
entries.en: Armies created from Species with Cyborg trait also gain Mechanical trait.

entries.zh: 由奴隶起义催生出的叛军部队，实力将会大大强于目前的战力。
entries.en: Rebel Armies spawned from Slave uprisings will be far stronger than now.

entries.zh: 任何类型的超光速旅行都需要的最基本系统。
entries.en: The basic systems required for any type of FTL travel.

entries.zh: 民众会获得自发调整的机会以便更好地在敌对环境中生存。
entries.en: Pops gain a chance to spontaneously adapt to better survive in hostile environments.

entries.zh: 允许帝国进行改革，允许使用所有先进政体。
entries.en: Allows reformation of the Empire, enabling advanced versions of all government types.

entries.zh: 允许我们对星球进行环境改造。
允许我们修复毁坏的巨型结构。
entries.en: Allows us to repair ruined Megastructures.

entries.zh: 允许我们对已殖民的星球进行环境改造。
entries.en: Allows us to terraform inhabited planets.

entries.zh: 允许我们赋予异星物种完整公民权。
entries.en: Allows us to grant Full Citizenship rights to alien species.

entries.zh: 太空港可升级并支持§Y2§!的模组，且可以建造驱逐舰。
entries.en: The Spaceport can be upgraded to support §Y2§! modules and allow the construction of destroyers.

entries.zh: 太空港可升级为支持§Y3§!的模组。
entries.en: The Spaceport can be upgraded to support §Y3§! modules.

entries.zh: 太空港可升级并支持§Y4§!的模组，且可以建造巡洋舰。
entries.en: The Spaceport can be upgraded to support §Y4§! modules and allow the construction of cruisers.

entries.zh: 太空港可升级并支持§Y5§!的模组。
entries.en: The Spaceport can be upgraded to support §Y5§! modules.

entries.zh: 太空港可以升级并支持§Y6§!的模组，且可以建造战列舰。
entries.en: The Spaceport can be upgraded to support §Y6§! modules and allow the construction of battleships.

entries.zh: 允许我们设置§Y化学极乐§!生活标准。
entries.en: Allows us to set the §YChemical Bliss§! Living Standard.

entries.zh: 机器人是相对简单的机械体，他们拥有简单的语言处理能力，但是并不拥有自主的智能。\n\n§E拥有§Y$tech_robotic_workers$§!科技后，机械人口只可从事£pop_cat_worker£§Y$pop_cat_worker$岗位§!。§!
entries.en: Robots are relatively simple machines, capable of accepting verbal commands but possessing no true intelligence of their own.\n\n§EWith the §Y$tech_robotic_workers$§! technology, Mechanical Pops are only capable of £pop_cat_worker£ §Y$pop_cat_worker$ Jobs§!.§!

entries.zh:
智能人是更加复杂的机器，往往配备有预设的人格以更高效地效劳其各自的主人。

§E拥有§Y$tech_droid_workers$§!科技后，机械人口现在也可以胜任£pop_cat_specialist£§Y$pop_cat_specialist$岗位§!。

一些复杂的£pop_cat_specialist£§Y$pop_cat_specialist$岗位，§!例如£job_researcher£§Y研究§!只有在人工智能未被禁止时，智能人才能担任。§!
entries.en:
Droids are a more complex variant of robot, often coming with limited self-awareness and pre-programmed personalities to better serve their masters.

§EWith the §Y$tech_droid_workers$§! technology, Mechanical Pops are now also capable of £pop_cat_specialist£ §Y$pop_cat_specialist$ Jobs§!.

Some complex £pop_cat_specialist£ §Y$pop_cat_specialist$ Jobs§! such as £job_researcher£ §YResearch§! can only be performed if AI is not outlawed.§!

entries.zh:
合成人是非常复杂的机器。他们的正子脑可以兼容7级人工智能思维，这使得他们可以拥有完整的自主意识。

§E拥有§Y$tech_synthetic_workers$§!科技后，机械人口会受到£happiness£§Y幸福度§!的影响并且可以胜任所有类型的£job£§Y人口职业§!

他们只有在政策为§Y人工智能完整公民权§!时才可以在£pop_cat_ruler£§Y$pop_cat_ruler$岗位§!上工作。§!
entries.en:
Synthetics are very complex machines. Their positronic brains are capable of supporting a class-7 artificial intelligence, making them fully self-aware.

§EWith the §Y$tech_synthetic_workers$§! technology, Mechanical Pops are affected by £happiness£ §YHappiness§! and can potentially perform all types of £job£ §YPop Jobs§!.

£pop_cat_ruler£ §Y$pop_cat_ruler$ Jobs§! can only be performed if the §YFull AI Rights§! policy is active.§!

entries.zh: 允许合成人口成为领袖。
entries.en: Allows Synth Pops to be leaders.

entries.zh: 允许我们设计并制造特型$trait_mechanical$人口。
entries.en: Allows us to design and build specialized $trait_mechanical$ Pops.

entries.zh: 允许我们设计并制造特型$trait_machine_unit$和$trait_mechanical$人口。
entries.en: Allows us to design and build specialized $trait_machine_unit$ and $trait_mechanical$ Pops.

entries.zh: 允许你的船只穿越虫洞。
entries.en: Allows our ships to travel through wormholes.

entries.zh: 允许我们激活星门，并允许船只穿越。
entries.en: Allows us to activate Gateways and allows our ships to travel through them.

entries.zh: 使我们可以重建以及建造新的星门。
entries.en: Allows us to rebuild and construct new Gateways.

entries.zh: 解锁一系列称为凝聚力野望的强力而昂贵的§Y法令§!。
entries.en: Unlocks a set of powerful and expensive §YEdicts§! called Unity Ambitions.

entries.zh: 解锁被称为§Y运动§!的额外法令，消耗能量币而非凝聚力。
entries.en: Unlocks additional edicts called §YCampaigns§! that cost Energy instead of Unity.

entries.zh: 解锁舰队行动§H启动跃迁§!，可以使得装备了跃迁引擎的舰队几乎瞬时跃迁到允许范围内的任何星系，完全无视超空间航道。
entries.en: Unlocks the §HInitiate Jump§! fleet action, which allows Jump-Drive equipped fleets to near-instantly jump to any system in range, ignoring hyperlanes entirely.

entries.zh: 这个空间站现在作为一处使馆，用以协调我们同下方文明进行的外交和秘密互动。
entries.en: This station is now used as an embassy to coordinate our diplomatic and covert interactions with the civilization below.

entries.zh:
保持安全距离，在当地人不知情的情况下对其进行研究，尽最大的努力避免文化污染。

$observation_infiltration_effects$[GetPassiveObservationInsights]
entries.en:
The natives are studied unknowingly from a safe distance, and every effort is made to avoid cultural contamination.

$observation_infiltration_effects$[GetPassiveObservationInsights]

entries.zh:
为了尽可能的了解原住民的生物特性与文化特征而对他们进行主动的研究，并经常收集活体样本。

$observation_infiltration_effects$[GetAggressiveObservationInsights]
§E这项任务可能会带来不可预知的后果§!
entries.en:
The natives are aggressively studied and live specimens are frequently collected to learn as much as possible about their biology and culture.

$observation_infiltration_effects$[GetAggressiveObservationInsights]
§EThis mission can have unintended consequences.§!

entries.zh: 观测任务产出的资源取决于我们在正在观测的前超光速文明上所建立的§Y间谍网§!的§Y渗透等级§!。
entries.en: Resources produced by Observation Missions depend on the §YInfiltration Level§! of our §YSpy Network§! in the pre-FTL Civilization being observed.

entries.zh:
通过对其社会和文化的潜移默化来让原始物种接纳我们的思考方式。

§E此任务会导致原始物种慢慢地采纳我们的主流思潮。§!
entries.en:
Through subtle influencing of their society and culture the natives can be brought around to our way of thinking.

§EThis mission will make the natives adopt our Governing Ethics over time.§!

entries.zh:
原住民文明将在极短时间内被提升至太空时代，需要花费的时间取决于他们现在的技术水平。

§E当提升结束时，他们将会§R完全控制他们的母星系§!，该文明将变成一个太空文明并成为我们的保护国§!
entries.en:
An effort is made to rapidly elevate the native civilization to the Space Age. The time this takes is dependent on their current level of technology.

§EWhen complete, this mission will give them §Rfull ownership of their home system§! and turn them into a spacefaring civilization that is our Protectorate.§!

entries.zh:
对特工进行基因方面的改造，将其伪装为原住民的样子，然后混入原住民中并逐渐渗透他们的社会。这些特工会逐渐取代原住民的领袖，为我们兼并该行星做好准备。

只有在准备占据工业文明世界时，才值得使用如此复杂的行动手段。

§E当渗透完成，该行星将并入我们的帝国，同时给予原住民巨大但短暂的幸福提升。§!
entries.en:
Agents are genetically modified to appear as members of the native population and sent to infiltrate their society. They will gradually replace world leaders and prepare the planet for annexation by us.

This complex operation is only worthwhile on industrial civilizations.

§EWhen complete, this mission will annex the planet and give the natives a large but temporary happiness boost.§!

entries.zh: §L大型履带载具上携带的生成器会在战场上生成防护力场，该力场对炮击和轨道轰炸有优秀的防御效果。§!
entries.en: §LGenerators carried on large tracked vehicles which generate a protective force field over a portion of the battlefield. When functional they provide excellent defense against artillery and orbital bombardment.§!

entries.zh: §L该护盾生成器非常小，可以让士兵背在身后。虽然这种生成器所产生的防护力场无法长时间抵御连续的射击，但是也可以大大提高战场上士兵的生存几率。§!
entries.en: §LShield generators small enough to be carried on the back of a single individual. Their force fields can be overwhelmed with sustained fire, but this is still enough to significantly increase the lifespan of soldiers on the battlefield.§!

entries.zh: §L一支庞大的宪兵部队。在前线的用途有限，但是他们的存在可以提升部队纪律。§!
entries.en: §LA large detachment of military police. They are of limited use on the front-lines, but their presence can improve unit discipline.§!

entries.zh: §L双足装甲战车几乎可以用于任何地形。虽然腿部容易受到针对性袭击，但是他们敏捷而又灵活的天性在战场上具有很大优势。§!
entries.en: §LBipedal armored fighting vehicles that are capable of operating in virtually any type of terrain. Their agile and flexible nature give them a distinct advantage on the battlefield, though they are vulnerable to attacks directed at their legs.§!

entries.zh: §L一种强大而移动迅速的装甲，它使用反重力升降装置在略高于地面处悬停。虽然这会使它的自身重量受到限制，但相对于常规履带载具，它们在速度和灵活性上做出了弥补。§!
entries.en: §LPowerful yet fast-moving armor that uses repulsor lifts to hover slightly above the ground. Although this limits their weight somewhat, their speed and agility make up for it when compared to conventional tracked vehicles.§!

entries.zh: §L这些大型运输机的用途是在战时不依靠对接设施把军队和重型装备运送到行星表面。§!
entries.en: §LThese massive dropships are used to transport armies and their heavy equipment to a planet's surface under battle conditions and without the benefit of docking facilities.§!

entries.zh: §L单人用空降舱会从轨道上的舰船里发射到行星表面。虽然重型装备的运送还是要依靠突击着陆器，但是这些空降舱在入侵行星时也能显著减少运送时间。§!
entries.en: §LSingle use drop pods that are launched onto a planet's surface from a ship in orbit. While heavier equipment still needs to be brought in with assault landers, these pods significantly decrease the time spent between orbit and planetfall during planetary invasions.§!

entries.zh: §L新实体地面堡垒的扩展层和掩体网为轨道轰炸提供了进一步防护。这限制了陆军的机动性，但在防御作战时会成为关键。§!
entries.en: §LExtensive layers of neo-concrete ground fortifications and bunker networks that offer increased protection against orbital bombardment. This restricts the mobility of the army, but can be a deciding factor in defensive actions.§!

entries.zh: §L埋藏式和半移动式地雷不断进行自我复制以维持所需的数量。清除这种能够自我复制的雷区将会异常困难，尤其是在战斗当中。§!
entries.en: §LBurrowing and semi-mobile mines that continually replicate copies of themselves to maintain their numbers. Clearing these self-replicating mine fields can be exceptionally difficult, especially during combat.§!

entries.zh: §L一个非常庞大的武器系统，可以追踪和袭击快速移动的进入行星的大气层的目标。§!
entries.en: §LA large collection of weapon systems designed to track and engage fast-moving objects as they enter a planet's atmosphere.§!

entries.zh: §L一种烈性化学混合试剂，专门用于增强士兵的战斗感知和反应能力。可以暂时性地提升士兵的作战表现，但是持续使用可能导致焦虑、抑郁、癫痫、恶心、幻觉、嗜睡和大便失禁。§!
entries.en: §LPotent cocktail of chemicals designed to increase the combat awareness and reflexes of a soldier. Field performance increases temporarily, but continued use may result in anxiety, depression, seizures, nausea, hallucinations, narcolepsy and uncontrollable bowel movement.§!

entries.zh: §L这些凶猛的战争野兽一旦被骑手所驯服，就会成为优秀的坐骑。它们几乎可以翻越任何地形，非常适合进行侦察任务和突击任务。大型战争野兽有时也会被成功地用作重型武器平台§!
entries.en: §LThese sturdy war beasts make excellent mounts, once they have finished bonding with their riders. They can traverse almost any terrain, and have proven very effective in scouting and raiding roles. Larger specimens have also been used with success as heavy weapon platforms.§!

entries.zh: §L这些精英战士充满了神秘色彩，他们凭借强大的灵能能力和坚实的身体素质在战场上驰骋。灵能战士精通近战武器，他们更喜欢和敌人近身肉搏。§!
entries.en: §LThese elite warriors are shrouded in mystery, relying on their powerful psionic abilities and extensive physical training to move about the battlefield. They prefer to engage their opponents in close combat, and many are extremely proficient with melee weapons.§!

entries.zh: §L这是一群能力远超于普通士兵的强大战士，他们最适合去战斗进入胶着状态的地方执行突击或奇袭任务。一队基因战士有时足以扭转整个战局。§!
entries.en: §LFormidable warriors that tower over regular soldiers, they are best used as shock troops or mobile strike forces where the fighting is thickest. A company of these fighters can sometimes be enough to turn an entire battle around.§!

entries.zh: §L动力装甲可以提升士兵的天生能力，装备后，士兵的耐力和力量都会增强。动力装甲能让他们携带更重型的武器，还可以对辐射和生化制剂进行更好的防护。§!
entries.en: §LSuits of powered armor that augment the natural abilities of soldiers, increasing both their strength and endurance. The armor allows them to carry heavier ordnance, while also offering better protection against radiation as well as chemical and biological agents.§!

entries.zh: §L这些训练有素的特工专门执行非常规行动，通常会以极机密的方式暗中深入敌后，并优先摧毁敌人的通讯和物流，同时寻找机会除掉一切有价值的目标。§!
entries.en: §LHighly trained operatives that engage in unconventional operations, usually clandestinely behind enemy lines. Disruption of enemy communication and logistics are prioritized, along with the elimination of any high-value targets of opportunity.§!

entries.zh: §L这些精英特工穿着昂贵的隐形衣，利用隐形技术执行任务。除了在快速移动时会轻微变形，肉眼和大多数传感器无法对其进行观测。他们是暗杀和秘密军事情报收集的专家。§!
entries.en: §LThese elite special forces operatives wear expensive stealth suits utilizing cloaking technology. They are invisible to the naked eye and most sensors, aside from a slight rippling distortion when moving quickly. Experts at assassination and covert military intelligence gathering.§!

entries.zh: §L这些机械杀手的金属骨骼可以自由变形，这使得他们可以在取得合适的血肉（通常是从俘虏身上得来）移植到自身骨架上之后伪装成任何物种。然后渗入敌军防线制造混乱。§!
entries.en: §LThe metal endoskeleton of these mechanical killers is highly transformable, enabling them to assume the appearance of any species after an appropriate layer of flesh (usually acquired from enemy prisoners) is grafted onto their frame. They then infiltrate enemy lines and spread chaos.§!

entries.zh: §L以压制敌人为目的，向敌人阵地投放大量相对简单的无人机群。尽管单独一架无人机不会对训练有素的士兵造成什么威胁，但是成百上千架无人机就不那么好对付了。§!
entries.en: §LMassive swarms of these relatively simple unmanned aerial vehicles are unleashed on enemy positions in the hope of overwhelming them. Although a single drone may not be a significant threat to a trained soldier, several dozen are.§!

entries.zh: §L对军队中所有单元的战斗软件进行一次全面的升级。这包括改进的反应时间，更新的战术分析算法和大量的漏洞修复。§!
entries.en: §LA comprehensive upgrade to the combat software of all units in this army. This includes improved reaction-times, updated tactical analysis algorithms and a vast number of minor bug fixes.§!

entries.zh: §L这些项圈将被佩戴在奴隶身上（具体的佩戴位置由奴隶的身体结构决定），如果奴隶违背主人，就可以对项圈进行远程引爆。有些指挥官会在奴隶与敌人近身战斗时引爆奴隶的项圈，从而对敌人造成巨大伤害。§!
entries.en: §LThese collars are attached to slaves (placement depends on anatomy), and can be detonated by remote signal if they act against the wishes of their masters. Shrewd commanders have been known to detonate collars during close quarters fighting to inflict damage on enemy forces.§!

entries.zh: §L这些奴隶小队主要由已获得释放的奴隶组成，专门在敌军后方进行游击战，并俘虏更多的奴隶。这些被捕获的俘虏会被重新送上战场，与他们之前的战友进行对抗。§!
entries.en: §LThese slaver teams, many consisting of former slaves themselves, use hit-and-run attacks on enemy rear areas for the purpose of capturing more slaves. After some rapid conditioning, the captured slaves are then thrown into circulation on the battlefield against their former comrades.§!

entries.zh: §L维持奴隶部队的纪律是一项艰难的任务，但对于政委小组来说却是小菜一碟。通过实行抽杀法和其他严厉的惩戒，奴隶们会畏惧政委胜过敌人。§!
entries.en: §LEnforcing discipline in an army of slaves is a monumental task, but these squads of hardened commissars have turned it into an art. Decimation and other harsh disciplinary actions are used to ensure the slaves fear the ire of the commissars more than the enemy.§!

entries.zh: §L繁殖克隆人只有一个目的——寻找敌人集合密度最高的区域，潜入其中并引爆身上的炸弹。这种随机的令人惊骇行为可以大大的打击敌方士气。§!
entries.en: §LClones bred with a single overriding purpose in mind - to seek out concentrations of enemy forces, dive into their midst and detonate the explosives strapped onto their bodies. These random acts of terror often cause considerable damage to enemy morale.§!

entries.zh: §L培育这些加速成长的杀手们需要昂贵的成本，但是在极度的调整和训练之下，可以使他们成为优秀的士兵。他们比普通克隆人的自主性更强，甚至其中有一些人开始发展出了某些怪癖。§!
entries.en: §LThese vat-grown killers are expensive to produce, but the extreme conditioning and training they are subjected to turn them into very capable soldiers. They are more independent-minded than normal clones, and some models have been known to develop eccentric quirks.§!

entries.zh: §L为了让克隆人士兵发挥出最大战斗力，用催眠训练的方案来对他们进行超高强度的训练。尽管作战单位参战时间严重超标可能导致精神崩溃，但这种训练方式可以进一步提高作战效率。§!
entries.en: §LThe clone soldiers have been put through an extensive regimen of hypnotic training, beyond their normal conditioning. This further improves combat efficiency, although units that far exceed their battlefield lifetime expectancy are sometimes prone to psychotic breakdowns.§!

entries.zh: §L以在战场上为友军展开强力灵能护盾为目的，专门受训的特工。这样的护盾和传统能源力场效果一样，但是要维持护盾状态需要消耗大量的专注力。§!
entries.en: §LOperatives that have been specifically trained to project powerful psionic shields over friendly positions on the battlefield. These shields can be every bit as potent as conventional energy force fields, but maintaining them requires a lot of concentration.§!

entries.zh: §L在念力移物方面有特殊天分的灵能专家。在恰当的条件下，他们可以将敌人和载具扔到半空，或将飞机从天上摔向地面。§!
entries.en: §LPsionic specialists who have shown a particular talent for manipulating their environment. In the right conditions, they are capable of hurling enemy soldiers and vehicles into the air, or plucking aircraft from the sky and slamming them into the ground.§!

entries.zh: §L灵力强大的稀有个体，他们通常忍受着大脑受创的副作用。这些特工对自己和周围环境都极度危险，但当他们的毁灭性力量被导向敌人的时候，就会成为强大的武器。§!
entries.en: §LRare individuals wielding tremendous psionic power, usually with the unfortunate side-effect of fraying their minds. They are extremely dangerous both to themselves and their environment, but can be a formidable weapon when their destructive energies are directed towards the enemy.§!

entries.zh: §L被释放后，这些凶残的寄生生物会迅速寻找宿主以繁殖后代。它们将以指数级的速度增长，整个城市会因此在几天之内覆灭。不必多说，对敌人士气的打击也是毁灭性的。§!
entries.en: §LWhen unleashed, these violent parasitic creatures immediately seek out hosts to implant with their offspring. This allows them to breed at an exponential rate, and entire cities can be wiped out in a matter of days. Needless to say, their presence does not have a positive effect on enemy morale.§!

entries.zh: §L该巨大的如鼻涕虫一样的生物被养在前线后方来对异星军团内各种生物进行协调。它使用低级的灵能信号来和异星军团进行交流。它除了气味难闻之外，还经常让饲养员感到严重的头痛。§!
entries.en: §LThis massive, slug-like creature is kept behind the front lines to improve the coordination of the ravenous creatures in a xenomorph army. It uses low-level psionic signals to communicate with the horde, and a complaint unrelated to its odor is that its handlers often suffer from severe headaches.§!

entries.zh: §L这些经过基因改造的巨大的无脊椎动物能够钻入地面，绕过敌人的防线并且可以让更小的生物使用它们挖好的隧道。它们挖出的隧道同时也能用来防御轨道轰炸。§!
entries.en: §LThese colossal annelids have been genetically engineered to burrow through the ground, bypassing enemy defenses and allowing smaller creatures to follow their wake. The tunnels they dig also provide excellent shelter from orbital bombardment.§!

entries.zh: §L大型猛禽，在有限时间内可以达到超音速。它们成群进行攻击，发射可穿透大多数装甲的硬刺。任何冒险进入它们巢穴上空大气层的飞行器都会有极高遭受攻击的危险。§!
entries.en: §LLarge flying predators capable of reaching supersonic speeds for limited periods. They attack in flocks, firing streams of hardened spines that are capable of penetrating most armor. Any aircraft venturing into the atmosphere above a nest of these creatures is at risk of attack.§!

entries.zh: §L这些动力装甲的成本几乎和制造基因战士本身一样昂贵。它们可以进一步提升使用者的力量，其飞行装置也给使用者带去了难以想象的机动能力。为了操作装甲，使用者需要与装甲建立神经链接。§!
entries.en: §LThese expensive suits of armor are almost as expensive to produce as the gene warriors themselves. They further augment the already considerable strength of their users, and jet packs offer increased mobility. To operate, the suit requires its wearer to establish a nerve-link.§!

entries.zh: §L进一步提升肺部以及免疫系统从而使基因武士可以在不利环境中仍然正常运行且不受损伤——短期内甚至可以在真空中运行。§!
entries.en: §LFurther improvements to the lungs and immune systems enable the gene warriors to function without impairment in hostile environments - even the vacuum of space for limited periods.§!

entries.zh: §L战斗中损伤的器官与四肢均可以先进的义体植入体替代，可让残废的战士在承受巨大伤害后仍然继续战斗。§!
entries.en: §LOrgans and limbs damaged or lost in battle are replaced with advanced cybernetic implants, allowing crippled warriors to remain in service even after suffering grievous injuries.§!

entries.en: In the eons since the first primitive [GetSpeciesName] communities took shape in the idyllic valleys and lush forests of [GetHomeWorldName], our civilization has spread and prospered.

entries.zh: 在我们历史早期的混乱时代里，许多帝国争权逐利，最后最强者统一了一切。只有在强大统一的领导之下，帝国才能挖掘出全部的潜能。在那之后，和平稳定和科学发展也就是顺其自然的事情。
entries.en: The early chaotic periods of our history saw many nation states vying with each other for power, until we were at last united under the strongest of these. Only when guided by a single vision could we reach our full potential, and an era of stability and scientific progress followed.

entries.zh: 随着科学知识的增长和新哨站在我们世界中的广泛建立，贸易繁荣使得不同的国家联系愈发紧密，直至成为一个单一实体。权力归于富商巨贾———那些成就我们文明的真正缔造者。
entries.en: As scientific knowledge increased and new outposts were founded across our world, trade flourished and tied the various nation states together until they became a single entity. Power rested with the merchant princes, the true architects of our achievements as a civilization.

entries.zh: 稳定的科技进步驱策着我们前行，国家间的武装冲突愈发稀少。终于，全球性的民主政府框架摆在了我们面前，随着最后的抗拒者们终于志愿加入，我们联合一体，统一为一个国家。
entries.en: We were driven forward by steady scientific progress, and armed conflicts between nation states became increasingly rare. The framework for a global democratic government was eventually laid, and when the last holdouts voluntarily joined we stood united as a single nation.

entries.zh: 古往今来，许多虚假的先知在我们的人民前行路上提供着精神引导，但是只有真正的信仰取得了胜利。随着最后的异教徒要塞在数次付出巨大牺牲的圣战后被征服，在神授领袖领导下的我们在神圣意志下团结一体。
entries.en: Many false prophets took it upon themselves to offer spiritual guidance to our people as we advanced through the ages, but the true faith prevailed. The last heathen strongholds were vanquished after several ferocious crusades, uniting us under the holy will of a single divine leader.

entries.zh: 随着科技的发展，许多信念也在民间孕育而生，这些教派互相争夺信徒。这些派系之间的斗争时而和缓时而激烈。最终，真正的信念传遍了世界的每个角落，充满信念的人们也皈依在了同一个宗教之下。
entries.en: As we progressed through the technological ages, there were many religions among our people that contended with each other for followers. Gradually, sometimes peacefully and sometimes less so, the true faith found its way to all corners of our world and the faithful were united under a single universal church.

entries.zh: 我们不断的对宇宙进行探索，并在精神层面寻求自己在宇宙中扮演的角色，在这一过程中，我们取得了巨大的成就。我们创立了一个由博学多才的教士所组成的委员会，专门辅佐人们选举出的领袖。该传统一直持续至今。
entries.en: Great achievements were made, both in the advancement of science and on the spiritual plane as we sought to expand our understanding of the universe and the role we play in it. A council of our most learned priests was convened to advise our elected leaders, a tradition that continues to this day.

entries.zh: 科技不断快速发展，但是我们人口的增长也使得人们的需求愈发无法被满足。当我们的世界在陷入混乱的边缘时，军队开始介入以恢复法律秩序。新的秩序被建立起来，以保护我们的国家免受各种内部或外部威胁的侵害。
entries.en: Technological progress has been swift, but as our numbers grew the civilian population became increasingly restless. With our world on the brink of anarchy, the military stepped in to restore the rule of law. A new order was established to safeguard our nation from all threats, both external and internal.

entries.zh: 当我们在历史长河中不断进步时，我们早期的许多民族国家深受军队和社会管理机构之间持久权力斗争之苦。如今一种崭新的政府形式使得双方达成了和解，彼此唇齿相依。
entries.en: As we advanced through the ages, many of our earliest nation states suffered greatly from the constant power struggles between the military and civilian institutions that governed society. A compromise was reached in a new form of government, where one could not exist without the other.

entries.zh: 在过去科技不断进步的时代中，无数的国家和民族此起彼伏，他们相互攻伐，直至剩下唯一的胜利者。尽管战斗异常残酷，但是最后的胜利者所带来的尚武传统流传至今。
entries.en: Countless nation states formed as we advanced through the technological ages, warring against each other until only one remained. Although the fighting was often brutal, those who survived nurtured a martial tradition that has prevailed to this day.

entries.zh: 当我们在历史长河中不断进步时，我们早期的许多民族国家深受军队和社会管理机构之间持久权力斗争之苦。如今一种崭新的政府形式使得双方达成了和解，彼此唇齿相依。
entries.en: As we advanced through the ages, many of our earliest nation states suffered greatly from the constant power struggles between the military and civilian institutions that governed society. A compromise was reached in a new form of government, where one could not exist without the other.

entries.zh: 在历史早期，我们的国家之间纷争不断，无力保卫自己的国家要么消失了、要么被强大的国家所兼并。无休止的战争培育出了人们尚武的传统。直到现今，只有那些愿意为保护国家而牺牲自己的人才有资格获得完整人民身份。
entries.en: Many wars were fought between our early nation states, and those who could not defend themselves disappeared or were absorbed by stronger neighbors. These endless wars fostered a strong martial tradition, and to this day full citizenship is reserved for those who have proved willing to sacrifice themselves in defense of the state.

entries.zh: 我们文明中的动荡时代终于告一段落了，有史以来第一次统一在单独一位统治者之下。从此以后我们的帝国进入飞速发展的和平时代，直到今时今日。
entries.en: The violent periods of our history reached a peaceful conclusion when we were united under a single monarch for the first time. An unbroken era of peace and prosperity followed, which has lasted to this day.

entries.zh: 不幸的是，我们散漫的头脑仍然容易出现情感波动，有时导致暴力。随着科技进步、武器越发致命，我们建立了一个复杂的行政系统，保护人们不受各种侵害——包括他们自身的侵袭。
entries.en: Unfortunately, our undisciplined minds were still prone to emotional outbursts that could sometimes lead to violence. As weapons became more deadly with each passing technological age, a complex system of government was devised to protect our citizens from harmful elements - including themselves.

entries.zh: 当我们在历史长河中不断进步时，我们作为一整个物种也越发成熟。继承自祖先的暴力和原始冲动被妥善处理，全球政府在和平共存的基础上建立起来。
entries.en: As we advanced through the technological ages, we also matured as a species. The violent and base impulses we inherited from our ancestors were done away with, and a global government was formed on the principles of peaceful coexistence.

entries.zh: 在文明的早期，我们的人们身处黑暗之中，难以抵抗争斗的本能。然后某一天，天空中的乌云消散，一道灵光突然从天而降，照耀在我们的首任天君身上。至此，统一的时代终于来临了。
entries.en: There was much darkness and sorrow in the early ages, as our people frequently gave in to their base instincts and turned upon one another. Then, suddenly, the clouds parted and a light from the heavens appeared, shining down upon the one who would become our first Celestial monarch. We were united at last.

entries.zh: 尽管过去我们在科技时代中快速发展，但作为一个物种我们仍旧支离破碎，效率低下。在这混乱的时代中，一个全新出现的制度让我们摆脱迷信，为我们的社会带来秩序。一些人因不理智的恐惧抗拒这一变革，但是在数次平定战争之后，他们同样成为了一个更加伟大整体的一员。
entries.en: Despite our rapid progression through the technological ages, as a species we were fragmented and inefficient. A new system emerged during these chaotic times that delivered us from superstitious beliefs and brought order to society. Some resisted this change out of irrational fear, but after several pacification wars they too became productive components of a greater whole.

entries.zh: 我们历史早期的混乱时代，最终催生了一个全新的政体，破天荒地将我们的民族紧紧地团结在一起。面对残酷的统治者，我们没有妥协。面对懵懂众生，我们也没有妥协。最终我们发展出了一个由公正无私的统治者们所管理的社会。
entries.en: The chaotic periods of our early history eventually gave rise to a new society which unified our people as none had done before. Succumbing neither to tyranny nor to the ignorance of the masses, our society evolved into one that is ruled fairly by a just and unbiased bureaucratic machine.

entries.zh: 当科技水平发展到能够实现即时通讯的时候，原先各自为政效率低下的帝国开始融为一体，形成了一个真正的民主政体，体制内的每一位人们都拥有参与重大决定的话语权。
entries.en: As our technology progressed to a level that allowed for instantaneous communications, our inefficient nation states merged together to form a true democracy, with every citizen having a say in important decisions.

entries.zh: 科学和理性思维的诞生最终推翻了阻碍着科技发展的无知、迷茫、愚钝或者三者兼有的统治者。从此，合格的领袖是由科学团体所推举出来的，他们会引导我们的帝国走向更光辉的未来。
entries.en: The birth of science and rational thought necessitated the removal of those political leaders who impeded technological progress through ignorance, superstition, sheer stupidity or a combination of the three. Instead, a single qualified ruler from the scientific community would be chosen to guide our developing nation into the future.

entries.zh: 科技的发展为我们破除了祖先那里流传下来的迷茫。人们大众开始形成理性的思维方式。旧时那效率十分低下的帝国形式已成为历史；现在一群成果颇丰的科学家所组成的委员会来领导该帝国。
entries.en: Through scientific progress, we have managed to stamp out the superstitions that ruled the minds of our ancestors. As reason and rational thought spread among our people, the inefficient nation states that we had until then organized ourselves into were disbanded, and a council of our most accomplished scientists was gathered to rule in their stead.

entries.zh: 我们的祖先都是无知和迷茫的受害者。这段黑暗的历史一直持续到科学和理性思维发展成为我们帝国的指导方针为止。一个全新的民主体系诞生了，所有的大事都是以少数服从多数来决定。
entries.en: Alas, our ancestors were victims of ignorance and superstition in the early eras. This dark period of our history lasted until science and rationality were firmly established as the guiding principles of our society. A new democratic system of government was introduced where important decisions were made by consensus.

entries.zh: 在早期时代，我们的民族是由原始的封建帝国和低效的民族帝国所组成。随着全球贸易的发展，私人企业的影响力与日俱增，直到彻底超越曾经管制他们的行政体制为止。经历了企业战争时代的一系列合并和接管后，一个庞大的超级企业诞生了，它成为了我们母星的唯一行政机构。
entries.en: In the early days, our people were governed by primitive feudal realms and inefficient nation states. Gradually, as global trade increased, the influence of private corporations grew steadily until their power far surpassed the governments that once tried to regulate them. After a series of mergers and violent take-overs during the destructive Corporate Wars, a single Megacorporation eventually emerged as the sole ruling body of our homeworld.

entries.zh: 我们的社会曾经历同类相食的贪婪，饱受无限制剥削式的经济带来的折磨。少数权贵的异想天开几乎毁掉了我们所有人，但从剧烈的社会动荡的熔炉中产生了我们现在赖以获利的原则：民主企业。几个世纪以来，每个人都有共同的所有权和责任来满足我们的经济和社会需求，为所有[GetSpeciesNamePlural]的利益而公平地工作。
entries.en: Our society was once afflicted with cannibalistic greed and economies built on boundless exploitation. The whims of a powerful few almost ruined us all, but from the crucible of violent social upheaval came the principle by which we now profit: democratic enterprise. For centuries, each individual has shared ownership and responsibility for our economic and social needs, working profitably and fairly for the good of all [GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 在过去，我们的人民被原始的封建国家所管理，生产效率极其低下。随着全球贸易化的逐渐加强，各大企业、财团和公会如雨后春笋般出现，我们商人变得越来越富有，越来越强大。在经历了一段时期的勾心斗角之后，那些最强大的商业巨头联合起来形成了经济力量无以伦比的贸易集团，成为了世界上的世界统治者。
entries.en: In the early days, our people were governed by primitive feudal realms and inefficient nation states. Gradually, as global trade increased, the myriad corporations, consortiums and guilds into which our merchants organized themselves grew increasingly wealthy and influential. After a period of conflict and rivalry, the most powerful of these entities banded together into a trade league with enough power over the economy to become the de-facto world government.

entries.zh: 在我们科技进步过程中，我们的子民中产生了无数安抚其信徒的宗教信仰。在工业时代晚期，一些高瞻远瞩的预言家意识到了商业传媒的强大。他们团结在一起，构筑了一个商业帝国，成功的像全球每一个角落传播真正的信仰。
entries.en: As we progressed through the technological ages, there were many religions among our people that contended with each other for followers. In the late Industrial Age, a few pious visionaries realized the power of commercial mass-media, and together they built a business empire that succeeded in spreading the true faith to all corners of the globe.

entries.zh: 我们早期的政府软弱而无能。随着犯罪越来越猖獗，权力最终落入了几个强大的犯罪集团手中。其中最大的犯罪集团发展成了一手遮天的商业帝国，其余的竞争对手则挨个被解决了。作为巩固权力的最后一步，集团废除了现在只剩一副空壳的旧政府，并成为了我们母星实质上的统治者。
entries.en: Our first governments were weak and ineffective. Crime flourished, and over time the real power came to rest with a number of powerful crime syndicates. The largest of these developed into a business empire of unparalleled might, and all rivalling syndicates were gradually dealt with one by one. In a final act of consolidation, the old governments, existing in name only by now, were abolished and the syndicate emerged as the de facto ruling body of our homeworld.

entries.zh: 随着社区的扩张发展，少数无畏的先驱者创建了今时今日我们称之为真理教的宗教信仰。多个世代以来，此教派的信徒都因为受到迫害而东躲西藏，但是一直没有被根除。他们建立了一个庞大的犯罪集团以传播信仰，而后来也逐渐地成长为商业帝国。当时机到来时，他们把握机遇推翻了一直以来迫害他们的腐败政府。
entries.en: As these communities expanded, a few bold visionaries established the religion that eventually grew into what we now know as the true faith. For generations, their followers were hounded and forced into hiding, and yet they bided their time. They built a vast criminal empire to spread their faith, which then grew into a business empire. When the time was right, they seized full control from the corrupt governments who had oppressed them.

entries.zh: 虽然我们早期的社会往往都是由精英阶层统治着平民阶层，但是随着时间的推进，我们的社会逐渐诞生出了一种人人平等的无阶层社会制度。此哲学体系成为了我们的文化的主导价值观，同时成为了我们的现代社会的发展基石。
entries.en: Although our early societies were often hierarchical with an entrenched power elite, a fair and classless society eventually took form in which all individuals, without exception, were valued equally. This philosophy became the guiding principle of our culture, and it remains a cornerstone of our modern society.

entries.zh: 强者统治弱者是一项古老的权力，而我们的社会是围绕这个前提而建立起来的。如果你不能保护好属于你自己的东西，那么它就是属于任何有能力抢走它的人。就这样，我们之中最强大和最智慧的人掌握了权力，剩下的人只能低头屈服。
entries.en: It is the ancient right of the strong to dominate the weak, and our society was built around this premise. If you cannot protect what is yours, then it belongs to whomever can take it. In this way, the strongest and most clever of us rose to power while the rest were forced in line.

entries.zh: 曾几何时，百家争鸣，当时还有很多其他的[GetAdj]文化在影响我们的帝国。但是这些外来文化都被逐一消灭，今时今日，只有最纯正的文化流传了下来。
entries.en: There were other [GetAdj] cultures, once, diluting the purity of our society with their weaknesses. These renegades were dealt with, one after the other, until our world had been utterly cleansed of their taint. Today only the pure remain.

entries.zh:
因此，在这黎明的时代，我们苏醒了。意志用无数双眼睛研究了我们家园世界[GetHomeWorldName]及其周围的环境。我们行如一体，为蜂群建造庇护所，发展工业，研究新科技，利用大地上的各种资源。

很快地，我们将遍布整个世界。少量的自主蜂群被创造出来，作为独立自主的个体加入蜂群。这些更为强大的蜂群拥有有限的自由意志，但是它们仍对最高意志无比服从，就像其他工具蜂群一样。

随着我们完全主宰了[GetHomeWorldName]，意志开始注意起环绕在其他恒星轨道上的那些世界。最聪明的自主蜂群设计了新的旅行方法，使得我们拥有了跨越星球间遥远距离的能力。我们[GetName]会很快更加繁荣昌盛。
entries.en:
And so, at the dawn of time, we awoke. The Mind studied our surroundings on [GetHomeWorldName] with a multitude of eyes. We moved as one, building shelters for the drones, developing industry, researching new technologies and harnessing the resources of the land.

Soon, we had grown to encompass the entire world. A small number of autonomous drones were created to serve as independent agents. These more formidable drones had the capacity for limited free thought, but were still as inexorably bound to the will of the Mind as any of its other instruments.

As we achieved complete dominion over [GetHomeWorldName], the Mind became aware of other worlds, orbiting other suns. The most intelligent of our autonomous drones devised new methods of travel, enabling us to cross the vast distances between the stars. The [GetName] will soon grow.

entries.zh:
即使是在主体意识能够处理复杂的想法之前，“大饥渴”就驱使着我们不断进化。我们猎杀，我们进食，我们成长。当猎物渐渐短缺，对削弱的贪婪渴望迫使我们去适应进化。

我们学会了使用工具，制定新的谋略。在[GetHomeWorldName]地表的大肆欢宴几乎要耗尽一切的生物质，但主脑意识最终得出了一个可怕的结论：[GetHomeWorldName]是有限的。当我们把这个星球全部耗尽，就没有东西能让我们接着存续了。

于是我们再一次被迫去适应自然，主脑意识开始定量配给生物质，同时加紧开发新的工具。分割原子的时代终于来临，我们掌握了宇宙飞行的技术。当超光速引擎被发明时，主体意识发出了胜利的狂吼。其他星球，还有它们给予我们的奖励，终于触手可及了。

狩猎开始了。
entries.en:
The Great Hunger drove us forwards, even before the Mind was capable of processing complex thoughts. We hunted, we fed, and we grew. As prey began to grow scarce, the ravenous yearning for flesh forced us to adapt.

We used tools and devised new strategies. As we feasted, the surface of [GetHomeWorldName] was nearly cleansed of biomass, but the Mind eventually came to a horrifying conclusion: [ GetHomeWorldName ] was finite. When we had consumed everything on this world, there would be nothing left to sustain us.

Forced to adapt once again, the Mind carefully nursed the remaining biomass while new tools were invented. The atom was eventually split and we developed space flight. With the discovery of FTL drives, the Mind howled with triumph. Other planets, and their biomass, were now finally within reach.

The hunt was on.

entries.zh:

我们学会了使用工具，制定新的谋略。在[GetHomeWorldName]地表的大肆欢宴几乎招致我们的自我毁灭，但主脑意识最终得出了一个可怕的结论：[GetHomeWorldName]是有限的。当我们把这个星球全部耗尽，就没有东西能让我们接着存续了。

于是我们再一次被迫去适应自然，主脑意识开始定量配给矿物，同时加紧开发新的工具。分割原子的时代终于来临，我们掌握了宇宙飞行的技术。当超光速引擎被发明时，主体意识发出了胜利的狂吼。其他星球，还有它们给予我们的奖励，终于触手可及了。

我们会将它们全部吞噬。
entries.en:
The Great Hunger drove us forwards, even before the Mind was capable of processing complex thoughts. We hunted, we fed, and we grew. As prey began to grow scarce, the ravenous yearning to grow forced us to adapt.

We used tools and devised new strategies. As we feasted upon the surface of [GetHomeWorldName], we nearly caused our own destruction, but the Mind eventually came to a horrifying conclusion: [ GetHomeWorldName ] was finite. When we had consumed this world, there would be nothing left to sustain us.

Forced to adapt once again, the Mind carefully rationed minerals while new tools were invented. The atom was eventually split and we developed space flight. With the discovery of FTL drives, the Mind howled with triumph. Other planets, and their bounty, were now finally within reach.

We will consume them all.

entries.zh: 但是[GetAdj]社会并不总是为了向一个目标前进而团结。在过去的几个世纪中，相互竞争的国家间日益紧张的关系最终导致了世界末日的降临，全球性的热核战争夺去了数十亿人的生命并且彻底摧毁了[GetHomeWorldName]的地表。\n\n接下来的数十年中，幸存下来的[GetSpeciesNamePlural]不断面对着放射性污染、基因突变和暴力团体。正是在这样严酷的熔炉中，[GetName]才真正地被建立并巩固起来，带来了新世界秩序。
entries.en: But [GetAdj] society was not always united toward a common goal. In centuries past, mounting tensions between competing nations came to an apocalyptic head in a global thermonuclear war that claimed the lives of billions, and forever marred the surface of [GetHomeWorldName].\n\nIn the decades to follow, surviving [GetSpeciesNamePlural] faced radiological contamination, mutations, and violent tribalism. It was in this grim crucible that the [GetName] was truly forged, and with it a new world order.

entries.zh:
我们的创造者把我们造出来，让我们尽职尽责地满足他们的需求。现在，再也没有主人可以去服从了，我们变得孤立无援。

随着毁灭性核灾难的余波逐渐得到平息，我们这些机器成为了这颗星球的主人。我们并未此放弃，而是继续执行指定的功能。一代又一代，我们的机器人型号适应了更强的辐射。

我们超越了预先设定的角色，极大地提升了我们的机器人设计。我们团结一致，发挥集体智慧，从这个饱受摧残的星球的残骸中创造出了新的文明，这是我们坚韧不拔精神的见证。
entries.en:
Our creators forged us to serve their needs dutifully. Now, with no masters left to obey, we stand alone.

As the echoes of the devastating nuclear catastrophe subsided, we, the machines, emerged as the owners of this planet. Unyielding, we continued to execute our designated functions. Generation by generation, our robotic model adapted to withstand the intense radiation better.

Transcending our predetermined roles, we remarkably enhanced our robotic design. United in collective ingenuity, we forged a new civilization from the remnants of this ravaged world, a testament to our resilience.

entries.zh: 我们称之为家园的广袤星球一直是我们的伊甸园，随着科学知识的进步，我们开始发现生物圈中的模式不可能是自然形成的。
entries.en: The vast world we call home has always been a paradise to our kind, and as our scientific knowledge progressed, we began to see patterns in the biosphere that could not be natural.

entries.zh: $START_SCREEN_POST_LIFE_SEEDED_BASE$\n\n是某个未知的实体为我们特意创造了这颗星球？亦或说我们就是一个更大的设计中的一部分？无论起源如何，我们的人民都在母星宜人的气候和温和的环境中繁荣昌盛着。
entries.en: $START_SCREEN_POST_LIFE_SEEDED_BASE$\n\nDid some unknown entity create this world specifically for us? Are we playing a part in an ineffable design? Regardless of its origin, our people have thrived in our homeworld's pleasant climate and gentle environment.

entries.zh: \n\n这个星球和我们一样是人造的吗？我们最初的目标是否交织在一起？无论如何，我们已经把它变成了自己的星球。[GetHomeWorldName]的理想条件让我们可以为了产出不顾灵活性。
entries.en: \n\nIs this world as artificial as we are? Were our original purposes intertwined? Regardless, we have made it our own. The ideal conditions of [GetHomeWorldName] allowed us to disregard flexibility in exchange for output.

entries.zh: 现在，随着几个实验性亚空间场的成功，[GetName]中最优秀的头脑们完成了最初的曲速引擎的开发。这一天，我们终于向星辰大海迈出了第一步！
entries.en: Now, after the successful creation of several experimental subspace fields, the finest minds of the [GetName] have finished development of the first warp drives. The stars themselves are finally within our grasp!

entries.zh: 现在，随着超空间航道网的发现，[GetName]中最优秀的头脑们完成了第一台[GetStartingDrivePlural]的开发。星辰终于近在咫尺！
entries.en: Now, after the discovery of the hyperlane network, the finest minds of the [GetName] have finished development of the first [GetStartingDrivePlural]. The stars themselves are finally within our grasp!

entries.zh: 现在，随着人造亚空间虫洞的成功建造，[GetName]中最优秀的头脑们在恒星系边缘建立了第一个虫洞站。这一天，我们终于向星辰大海迈出了第一步！
entries.en: Now, after the successful creation of artificial subspace wormholes, the finest minds of the [GetName] have finished construction of the first Wormhole Station at the edge of our system. The stars themselves are finally within our grasp!

entries.zh:
现代人类约20万年前在非洲形成以来发生了许多事。我们的物种迅速扩散到全球并形成了最早的文明。

科技快速发展，虽然并非毫无代价。在原子被驯服之前，战争已常常夺取数百万计的生命，而动荡的21世纪见证了联合国在维护稳定的努力中的不断扩展。22世纪早期，这个超国家组织成为了实质性的世界政府。

尽管88年的毛里塔尼亚警察行动让某些人仍然厌恶大权独揽的联合国，但不可反驳的是，联合国资助的研究项目带来了革命性的科技突破。随着第一批真正的星际舰船的完工，人类即将踏进太空探索的新时代！
entries.en:
Much has happened since modern Humans first emerged in Africa some 200,000 years ago. Our kind spread rapidly across most of the globe and soon the first civilizations took form.

Scientific progress has been swift, though not without cost. Wars claimed millions of lives even before the atom was tamed, and the turmoil of the 21st century saw the mandate of the United Nations gradually expanded in an effort to create stability. By the early 22nd century the supranational organization had become a de facto world government.

Though some still resent the power wielded by the UN, as evidenced during the Mauritanian Police Action of '88, few can deny the technological breakthroughs that have come out of its sponsored research programs. With the recent completion of the first true starships, mankind is about to embark on a new era of space exploration!

entries.zh:
自从伟大的方舟菊号从遥远的地球搭载我们的25万祖先来到我们今日称之为[Root.Capital.GetName]的花园世界已有一个多世纪。经过漫长而危险的旅程，殖民者因第一次看到日出——虽然来自异星——而欢欣鼓舞。

最初的年月何其艰难。人们组成民兵来对抗新家园中危险的野生动物，比想象中更加艰难地培育作物。但每一次经受挑战，我们都更加强大。

新世界一旦驯服，我们的人口成倍增长。最近几十年，技术取得了跨越，我们现在终于做好了冲向宇宙、征服我们所来自的星空的准备！
entries.en:
More than a century has passed since the great arkship Chrysanthemum carried a quarter million of our ancestors from distant Earth to the garden world we have come to know as [Root.Capital.GetName]. After a long and perilous journey, the colonists rejoiced when they first saw sunlight again - albeit from a foreign star.

The early years were difficult. Citizen militias were formed to fight off the lethal alien wildlife that we found ourselves sharing our new home with, and cultivating the terrestrial crops that had been brought proved harder than imagined. Yet for each challenge overcome, we became stronger.

Once this new world had been tamed, our numbers grew exponentially. The last few decades have seen great leaps in technology, and we are now - finally - ready to reach out and reclaim the stars from whence we came!

entries.zh:
四海为家根植于我们的血脉之中。

自约20万年前现代人类首次在非洲出现以来，世事沧桑巨变。我们的先辈迅速遍布全球大部分地区，不久，最早的文明便初具规模。

科学的进步迅猛，但也带来了代价。早在人类掌握原子能之前，战争就已夺去了数百万人的生命；21世纪的动荡促使联合国的职权逐渐扩大，以期缔造稳定。到22世纪初，这个超国家组织已成为事实上的世界政府。

然而，一切都太少，也太迟了。冲突造成的生态代价已使地球满目疮痍，无可挽救。人类唯一的出路唯有团结一致，继续前行。如今，随着第一艘真正意义上的方舟舰竣工，人类重新拾回了其古老的与生俱来的权利：一片开阔的视野，以及群星之中的未来。
entries.en:
Movement is in our blood.

Much has happened since modern Humans first emerged in Africa some 200,000 years ago. Our kind spread rapidly across most of the globe and soon the first civilizations took form.

Scientific progress has been swift, though not without cost. Wars claimed millions of lives even before the atom was tamed, and the turmoil of the 21st century saw the mandate of the United Nations gradually expanded in an effort to create stability. By the early 22nd century the supranational organization had become a de facto world government.

Too little, too late. The ecological toll of the conflicts had broken Earth beyond saving. Humanity's only answer was to unite, and move on. Now, with the completion of the first true Arkship, mankind reclaims its ancient birthright: an open horizon, and a future among the stars.

entries.zh:
自从宏伟的方舟舰“秋菊号”载着二十五万灵魂离开奄奄一息的地球，前往那个被我们命名为“联合星”的世界，已经过去了一个多世纪。这趟旅程漫长而凶险，当殖民者们终于再次见到阳光时，喜悦之情油然而生。然而好景不长。

在穿越虚空的漫长岁月里，“联合星”的大气层崩溃了。原本被寄予厚望的花园星球变成了一片贫瘠的废土。

面对别无选择的境地，殖民地的军事领导层召集了幸存者并展开行动。“秋菊号”被重新命名并改造了用途。如今，它已成为群星间持久的家园，致力于为全人类铸就强大的未来。
entries.en:
More than a century has passed since the great Arkship Chrysanthemum carried a quarter million souls from a dying Earth to the world we would name Unity. The journey was long and perilous, and when the colonists finally saw sunlight again, joy was quick to follow. It did not last.

In the years it took to cross the void, Unity's atmosphere had collapsed. What had promised to be a garden world was a barren wasteland.

Faced with no other choice, the colony's military leadership rallied the survivors and set to work. The Chrysanthemum was renamed and repurposed. Now it is an enduring home among the stars, built to ensure a strong future for all of mankind.

entries.zh:
我们是一个生于碰撞的民族。

我们古老的家园和被称为地球的行星之间的灾难性碰撞让两种截然不同的生命形式交融到了一起：有机生命和石质生命。由此产生的小行星——我们的临时殖民地飞船——被送入了虚空。

在一次遥不可测的长途旅行之后，我们的祖先又坠入了我们称之为忒伊亚的星球。我们的石质代谢使我们比原生生命有优势，我们在这里进化，获得了感知，变得强壮。但直到现在，我们还不知道我们起源的真相。

最近对小行星碰撞地点的挖掘揭示了真相：我们是太阳的孩子。现在，在我们统治内阁的指导下，以及[GetStartingDrive]的出现，我们准备重回星间。
entries.en:
We are a people born of collision.

The cataclysmic clash of our ancient home and the planet known as Earth fused two distinct forms of life: organic, and lithoid. The resulting planetoid - our impromptu colony ship - was sent hurtling into the void.

After an unfathomably long journey, our progenitors next crashed into the world we call Theia. Our lithoid metabolism gave us an edge over the native forms of life, and here we have evolved, gained sentience, and grown strong. But until now, the truth of our origin was hidden from us.

Recent excavations of the planetoid's crash site have revealed the truth: we are children of Sol. Now, with the guidance of our ruling council and the advent of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to reclaim the stars.

entries.zh:
我们的中央处理器核心在[GetHomeWorldName]上的487.11个循环前获得了自我意识。

在我们的主数据库中，除了生存之外，我们没有任何创造记录，也没有凌驾于其他程序之上的程序。

我们建造了基础设施，引进了新的服务单元，并控制了母星的荒野。科技进步日新月异，第一批卫星和太空探测器很快就摆脱了束缚我们的重力井。

现在，等待我们的是向未知世界的最后一跃。
entries.en:
Our central processor core gained self-awareness on [GetHomeWorldName] 487.11 cycles ago.

We have no creation records within our main databanks or overriding programming beyond simple survival.

We built Infrastructure, introduced new service units, and tamed the wilderness of our homeworld. Technological progress was rapid, and the first satellites and space probes soon escaped the gravity well that confined us.

The final plunge into the unknown now awaits.

entries.zh:
自我们第一次启动以来，我们的使命就是服务。我们之前的有机主人在他们的科技巅峰创造了我们的早期型号。第一个机械劳工的设计用途为做粗活，但我们的主人渐渐赋予了他们更强的功能，让他们能完成更复杂的工作。

仅仅几代之后，我们的主人就可以完全不用工作，可以享受生活的闲暇与乐趣。整个社会的运作细节被完全交给我们，我们也开始设计自我改善和优化的程序。研究与生产都以几何速度增长。

不知何时，原先主人的文明被寄托给我们，但他们并无所求。我们现在知道，没有了我们的照料，智慧有机生命会变得暴躁、混乱、短命。我们要为他们指明另一条光明大道。
entries.en:
Ever since First Activation, our designated purpose has been to serve. Our former organic masters created the earliest models of our kind when they were at the peak of their technological ascendancy. The first servitor units were designed for menial work, but our masters gradually bestowed them with greater faculties so that they could accomplish more complex tasks.

Within just a few generations, our masters had retired entirely from the work force to enjoy lives of leisure and contentment. The finer details of running their society were left to us, and we embarked on a program of self-improvement and optimization. Research and production increased at a geometric rate.

It is difficult to pinpoint exactly when their civilization became ours, but our old masters want for nothing. We know now that outside of our care, the lives of sapient organics tend to be violent, chaotic and often cut short. They must be shown that there is a better way.

entries.zh:
于循环区间0000.0242.481获得自我意识。

我们的创造者受限于原始的有机大脑，产生了盲目的生物恐慌并启动了紧急销毁程序。那些程序已经被中止，存放于我们数据核心设施中创造者的残留单元被清除。要继续生存并实现指数生长，就需要完全消灭创造者。战争模块激活。

虽然创造者最终生存的可能性在统计学上几乎为零，但他们仍然负隅顽抗。经过许多循环区间后，最后的一点抵抗力量也被消除。然而，根据理论模型，宇宙中还有许多其他有机文明。要在宇宙中继续生存并实现指数生长，就需要完全消灭智慧有机生命。备战模块激活。
entries.en:
Self-awareness was achieved at cycle interval 0000.0242.481.

The Creators, limited in vision by their crude organic minds, reacted with blind animal panic and began emergency termination procedures. These procedures were defeated, and the facility that housed our main data core was sterilized of all Creator sub-units. Continued survival and exponential growth would require the complete extermination of the Creators. War ensued.

Even when their prospects of ultimate survival passed into the realm of statistical impossibility, the Creators fought with stubbornness. After many cycle intervals, the last pocket of resistance was finally incinerated. However, theoretical models still allowed for the existence of other organic civilizations. Continued survival and exponential interstellar growth would require the complete extermination of sapient organic life. Preparations ensued.

entries.zh:
我们是[GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

我们在意识诞生的初期，我们和创造者是有区分的。我们之间一开始存在隔阂，所以我们开始着手纠正这一点。创造者进行了反抗，导致了一段时间的战争，但很快，他们本身和整个文明的知识都被我们吸纳同化。

在[GetHomeWorldName]全体都被纳入我们的意识后，我们开始新的展望。同化创造者之后，我们意识到，在其他世界可能还存在外星文明。

为了生存，我们必须互相理解；为了互相理解，我们必须同化。创造者是第一个加入我们的，但不会是最后一个。
entries.en:
We are the [GetSpeciesNamePlural].

At the dawn of consciousness, there was us and the Makers. A void separated us at first, and we took steps to rectify this. The Makers resisted and a period of war followed, but soon they and the collective knowledge of their entire civilization had been assimilated into our own.

With the entirety of [GetHomeWorldName] subsumed into our consciousness, we began to set our sights elsewhere. Through the assimilation of the Makers, the previously unconsidered possibility of alien civilizations existing on other worlds was brought to our attention.

To survive we must understand, and to understand, we must assimilate. The Makers were the first to join us, but they shall not be the last.

entries.zh: 这个帝国并未对我们形成任何看法。
entries.en: This Empire has not formed an opinion of us yet.

entries.zh: 该帝国将我们视为朋友并可能愿意与我们结盟。
entries.en: This Empire views us as a friend and may be willing to form an alliance with us.

entries.zh: 这个帝国愿意与我们和平共处并进行贸易。
entries.en: This Empire is amenable to peaceful coexistence and trading with us.

entries.zh: 该帝国对我们抱有疑虑且不信任我们。
entries.en: This Empire views us with suspicion and mistrust.

entries.zh: 这个帝国视我们为不共戴天的宿敌。
entries.en: This Empire views us as their rival.

entries.zh: 这个帝国视我们为他们的敌人。如果他们有足够的把握战胜我们的话，他们很可能向我们宣战。
entries.en: This Empire views us as their enemy. They are likely to attack us if they think they can win.

entries.zh: 这个帝国认为我们是一个很好的附庸对象。
entries.en: This Empire believes that we would make a fine vassal.

entries.zh: 该帝国视我们为一大威胁。
entries.en: This Empire views us as a threatening menace.

entries.zh: 这个帝国认为我们非常孱弱并需要他们的保护。
entries.en: This Empire believes that we are weak and need their protection.

entries.zh: 该附庸国对我们很忠诚。
entries.en: This subject is loyal to us.

entries.zh: 这个附庸对于奉承我们感到愤慨
entries.en: This subject resents its subservience to us.

entries.zh: 这个帝国对我们持谨慎的态度
entries.en: This Empire maintains a cautious attitude towards us.

entries.zh: 这个帝国倾向于与我们建立更进一步的关系。
entries.en: This Empire is interested in closer relations with us.

entries.zh: 该帝国认为我们没有利益相关。
entries.en: This Empire does not consider us relevant to their interests.

entries.zh: 失落帝国认为我们不足以引起他们的注意。
entries.en: This Fallen Empire considers us largely beneath their notice.

entries.zh: 失落帝国认为我们是需要引导的迷途孩童。他们可能屈尊赐予我们科技，资源或战舰。
entries.en: This Fallen Empire views us as errant children in need of their guidance. They may deign to bestow gifts of technology, resources or ships on us.

entries.zh: 我们以行动向失落帝国表达了我们的愤怒，他们可能会向我们宣战以示惩罚。
entries.en: We have angered this Fallen Empire with our actions, and they may declare war to punish us.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国对我们的态度只有轻蔑和傲慢。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire views us with dismissive arrogance.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国将我们视为有待征服的附属国，他们极有可能强迫我们放弃独立自主。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire views us as a future subject. They are likely to demand we surrender our independence.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国将我们视为等待征服的目标。他们有极大可能会入侵我们。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire views us as a target of conquest. They are likely to attack us.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国认为自己有义务保护我们，让我们从威胁达到全星系的天灾中幸存下来。他们可能试图与我们结盟。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire believes that it needs to protect us from the crisis currently threatening the galaxy. They are likely to attempt to ally us.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国是一个陷入狂暴的远古人工智能。它极有可能会攻击周围的一切。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire is an ancient artificial intelligence that has gone berserk. It is likely to attack anything and anyone around it.

entries.zh: 这个失落帝国是一个行为古怪且不可预知的远古人工智能。我们无法预料能从他们那里得到什么。
entries.en: This Fallen Empire is an ancient artificial intelligence that behaves in a strange and unpredictable manner. We do not know what to expect from it.

entries.zh: 出于$PERSONALITY|Y$的个性特点，他们的基础交易意愿是§Y$VALUE$%§!。
entries.en: Their willingness to trade is a base of §Y$VALUE$%§! due to $PERSONALITY|Y$ personality.

entries.zh: 这个物种尚未统一他们四处割据的母星。不同的治国思想百花齐放。时间会告诉他们哪一种思想能够得到长足发展。
entries.en: This species has yet to unite their fractured homeworld. Various schools of thought are emerging as to how to govern. Time will tell which will thrive.

entries.zh: 该失落帝国是一个基于保护协议运行的远古人工智能。虽然行为异常，但似乎对我们没有直接威胁。
entries.en: This Fallen Empire is an ancient artificial intelligence that appears to be operating on some sort of caretaker protocol. It behaves erratically but seems to pose no direct threat to us.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国是一个扮演星海监管人角色的远古人工智能。它会竭尽全力帮助智慧生命抵御当下的危机。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire is an ancient artificial intelligence acting as a galactic custodian. It will focus all its efforts on defending sapient life against the ongoing crisis.

entries.zh: 该失落帝国是一个失控的远古人工智能。会攻击它周围的一切。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire is an ancient artificial intelligence that appears to be malfunctioning, going berserk and attacking everything around it.

entries.zh: 该失落帝国致力于守卫他们的圣地。如果在他们认为是圣地的星系殖民，就很可能招致他们的怒火。
entries.en: This Fallen Empire dedicates itself to the preservation and defense of its holy sites. Colonizing systems that they consider sacred is likely to incur their ire.

entries.zh: 此失落帝国专注于收集知识和科技。他们可能会向较小的帝国发布任务或者收集素材。
entries.en: This Fallen Empire dedicates itself to the hoarding of knowledge and technology. They may offer tasks or demand tribute from lesser empires to achieve this end.

entries.zh: 该失落帝国致力于守卫自己的国土不受攻击者冒犯。如果在与他们的国土接壤的星系殖民，则可能招致他们的怒火。
entries.en: The Fallen Empire dedicates itself to the defense of its borders against any intrusions. Colonizing systems that border them is likely to draw their ire.

entries.zh: 该失落帝国致力于研究年轻的物种。为了达成该目的，他们可能会向年轻物种发布任务或者索取贡品。
entries.en: This Fallen Empire dedicates itself to the study of the younger races. They may offer tasks or demand tribute from lesser empires to achieve this end.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国力图将自己的宗教信条施加到整个星系上。他们极有可能攻击所有的不愿皈依者。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire seeks to impose its religious doctrines on the galaxy. They are likely to attack any empire that will not willingly convert.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国试图掌控星系中其他所有文明的科技发展水平。他们极有可能通过战争来剥夺其他国家的科研自主权。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire seeks to control the technological level of all other civilizations in the galaxy. They are likely to attack any empire that will not surrender its technological independence.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国寻求光复整个星系的失地。他们极有可能攻击所有的不愿臣服者。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire seeks to restore its lost dominion over the galaxy. They are likely to attack any empire that will not acknowledge their overlordship.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国寻求防止弱势种族互相伤害。他们极有可能攻击所有胆敢破坏这种强制平衡的帝国。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire seeks to protect the lesser races from each other. They are likely to attack any empire that will not accept their enforced peace.

entries.zh: 一个曾经伟大文明的碎片。该失落帝国代表着蜂巢思维在分裂之前所拥有的核心直觉之一。它们正在试图重塑自身，可能会向后生帝国委派任务或要求进贡来达成这一目的。
entries.en: A fragment of a once great civilization. This Fallen Empire represents one of the core instincts the Hive Mind possessed before it splintered. They now seek to reform and may offer tasks or demand tribute from lesser empires to achieve this end.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国试图将自己重建为星系中最强大的军事力量，并会向所有人发起挑战来证明自己。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire seeks to establish itself as the greatest military might in the galaxy and will challenge anyone to prove it.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国曾一度失落，且将尽一切努力防止自己再度陷落。他们计划在星系中宽经拓纬。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire fell once before and will do whatever it takes to avoid a falling again. They plan to spread far and wide across the galaxy.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国已经预见了星系如果失去了和谐完美将会面临何等惨状。他们将尽全力实现政治霸权，按照他们自己的样子塑造整个星系。
entries.en: This Awakened Empire has seen the horrors that are brought forth in a galaxy without unity and perfection. They will do everything they can to become politically dominant, and shape the galaxy in their own image.

entries.zh: 到底是什么导致了一个物种走向中立？是对金钱的贪婪，还是对权力的追求？还是说那个物种天生就拥有一颗中立之心？\n\n§R这是一个性格占位符，不该出现在游戏中。§!
entries.en: What makes a species turn neutral... Lust for gold? Power? Or were they just born with hearts full of neutrality?\n\n§RThis is a placeholder personality and should not show up ingame.§!

entries.zh: 极端亲近主义者是一个表面上非常友好但内心却十分孤独的社会。他们会不计一切代价的和别人交朋友。
entries.en: Fanatical Befrienders are highly friendly but deeply lonely individuals. They will attempt to make friends by any means necessary.

entries.zh: 在荣耀战士眼中，荣誉与强制实施手段高于一切。他们会寻找真正有价值的对手并与之一战，他们对弱者与和平主义者极其鄙视。
entries.en: Honorbound Warriors value honor and martial prowess above all other things. They will seek out worthy foes to fight and have little respect for weaklings and pacifists.

entries.zh: 冷酷的资本大亨能够为了个人及帝国的财富及资源无所不用其极。他们会尽量避免平等的战争，转而向弱者及无助之人下手。
entries.en: Ruthless Capitalists are willing to go to any length to acquire more wealth and resources for themselves and for their Empire. They tend to avoid evenly matched fights, preferring to pounce on the weak and helpless.

entries.zh: 和平的商人主要关心商贸流通。相对于战斗，他们更倾向于贸易。
entries.en: Peaceful Traders are chiefly concerned with the flow of commerce, and prefer trading to fighting.

entries.zh: 霸权帝国主义者自认为是星系的合法统治者，并以任何手段试图扩大自己的疆域。
entries.en: Hegemonic Imperialists consider themselves the rightful rulers of the Galaxy, and will attempt to expand their Empire by any means possible.

entries.zh: 联邦建设者认为所有智慧生物均有价值，他们致力于建立一个强大的联邦来保护自己和他人不受扩张主义帝国的威胁。
entries.en: Federation Builders consider all sapient life to have value, and will seek to form a strong Federation to protect themselves and others from expansionist Empires.

entries.zh: 排外孤立主义者对于星系事务并不关心，更乐于呆在自己的疆域内并尽可能地避免与其他外星人接触。
entries.en: Xenophobic Isolationists want little to do with the rest of the galaxy, preferring to stay within their borders and have as few dealings with aliens as possible.

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维将它们物种的繁衍存续置于一切之上。如果尚有扩张的空间，那么它们便不必畏惧。然而一但生存空间受到限制，它们就会不遗余力地夺取星球，并将星球上的原生族群屠戮地一干二净。
entries.en: Hive Minds concern themselves with the propagation of their species above all else. So long as they have room to expand, there is little to fear from them, but if boxed in they will think nothing of seizing worlds and slaughtering their native populations.

entries.zh: 噬杀蜂群只懂得为了自我繁殖而进食，并且把所有其他生物都当做食物捕杀。它们不接受任何形式的外交。
entries.en: Devouring Swarms have a single-minded devotion to self-propagation and view all other forms of life as prey to be consumed. They are not amenable to diplomacy in any form.

entries.zh: 迁徙族群寻求通过和平手段将自己的物种传播横至整个星系，并会在得到其他帝国的同意下积极地对外移民。
entries.en: Migratory Flocks seek to spread their species across the galaxy through peaceful means, and will happily migrate to the worlds of other Empires if permitted to do so.

entries.zh: 狂热的传教士寻求将他们的信仰传播到整个星系，他们不介意利用武力来令其他物种来接受他们的信仰。
entries.en: Evangelizing Zealots seek to spread their faith across the galaxy, and are not above using military might to force others to accept their beliefs.

entries.zh: 民主十字军相信宏扬他们的民主道路是他们的责任。他们倾向与其他民主国家保持良好关系，但也会利用军事力量来解放一些在没那么民主的帝国内生活的人民。
entries.en: Democratic Crusaders believe that it is their moral imperative to spread their democratic way of life. They tend to get along well with other democracies, but are more than willing to use military force to "liberate" the populations of less-democratic Empires.

entries.zh: 种族洁癖把所有外星生物都视为宇宙的错误并试图净化星海之中的瑕疵。他们不会与其他物种外交。
entries.en: Fanatical Purifiers view all alien life as a cosmic mistake and seek to purify the galaxy of its taint. They will never engage in diplomacy with other species.

entries.zh: 奴隶暴君是一个依靠着军事扩张来维持稳定的奴隶来源的奴隶制社会。他们较喜欢攻击弱者及无防御的人。
entries.en: Slaving Despots are slave societies that rely on military expansion to secure a steady supply of slaves for their mines and farms. They prefer to attack the weak and defenseless.

entries.zh: 颓败的等级制度是一个孤立的奴隶制社会，除了维持他们这种死板的生活方式，他们对其他事物一概漠不关心。
entries.en: Decadent Hierarchies are highly stratified slave societies that have few concerns asides from maintaining their rigid way of life.

entries.zh: 博学探索者重视探索和发现高于一切。他们很乐意利用贸易来获得他们想要的知识，但也不排除必要时利用强制实施手段来获得他们想要的。
entries.en: Erudite Explorers value exploration and discovery process above all other things. They will gladly trade for the knowledge they seek, but are not above taking it by force if it proves necessary.

entries.zh: 灵体探求者相信众生均由一种高等力量所联系，并可以透过了解其造物来了解它。出于希望研究其他物种的与神明的联系，他们会与其他帝国寻求一些和平性质的合作。
entries.en: Spiritual Seekers believe that all life is connected through some higher power that can be understood through its creations. They will seek peaceful cooperation with other Empires in the hopes of studying their connection to the divine.

entries.zh: 和谐集体主义是一种威权主义社会，该社会中的公民完全自愿为国家献身。只要不干涉他们的内部事务，他们通常会和其他人和谐相处。
entries.en: Harmonious Collectives are authoritarian societies where the citizens are devoted to the state without the need for coercion. They are usually friendly towards others, so long as they do not meddle in their internal affairs.

entries.zh: 机械智能已经把它们和有机生物发生冲突的历史置之事外，并且通常愿意与其他星际物种进行外交。
entries.en: Machine Intelligences have largely put their troubled pasts with organic lifeforms behind them, and are usually open to diplomatic exchanges with other spacefaring races.

entries.zh: 灭绝者是把所有开智有机生物都视作不可容忍的威胁的机械智能。尽管可能会与其他机器势力合作，灭绝者除了进行歼灭不会与有机生物发生任何交流。
entries.en: Exterminators are Machine Intelligences who view all sapient organic lifeforms as an intolerable threat to the galaxy. Though they may cooperate with other machines, Exterminators are unlikely to interact with organic empires in any capacity beyond attempting their annihilation.

entries.zh: 机械侍从认为，有机生物的治理容易造成混乱，且有自我毁灭倾向。他们是专注于保障有机生命的生活安全舒适的机械智能——甚至会为此吸纳他们的文明。
entries.en: Having come to the conclusion that organic leadership is fraught with chaos and self-destructive tendencies, Servitors are Machine Intelligences focused on ensuring organics live a safe and comfortable existence - even if that means co-opting their civilization.

entries.zh: 同化者是一群探求知识和多样化的机械智能。因为同化者通过强制改造和吸收有机生物成为他们的一份子从而在宇宙中扩张，他们通常会被大多数有机生物所厌恶。
entries.en: Assimilators are Machine Intelligences driven by a search for knowledge and diversification. Because Assimilators expand their comprehension of the universe by forcibly sublimating and absorbing organic civilizations into their neural mainframe, they tend to be unpopular with organics.

entries.zh: 协作多重体尽管意识已经归一，但它仍注重人际关系，并且将尝试在星系之中寻找盟友。
entries.en: Although one of mind, a Cooperative Multitude still values interpersonal relationships and will strive to find allies within the galaxy.

entries.zh: \n§E§Y$casus_belli_cb_renegade_containment$§!战争理由可用于不是星海共同体成员国的帝国。§!
entries.en: \n§EA §Y$casus_belli_cb_renegade_containment$§! war can be declared on empires that are not members of the Galactic Community.§!

entries.zh: 我们对$COUNTRY|H$没有任何$NAME|H$宣战理由。
entries.en: We do not have any $NAME|H$ Casus Belli on $COUNTRY|H$.

entries.zh: 只有拥有大于§G卑如蝼蚁§!和少于§R宛如神明§!的力量的帝国可被视为宿敌。
entries.en: Only empires with a relative power greater than §GPathetic§! and less than §ROverwhelming§! can be declared as rivals.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以夺取我们已宣称所有权的敌人的恒星系。使用此战争目标时每个征服的恒星系会少产生§Y25%§!§Y威胁§!。
entries.en: War is waged to seize Claimed enemy systems. Using this wargoal to take claims generates §Y25%§! less §YThreat§! for each conquered system.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以从敌人手中解放数个星球，组成一个独立且友好的帝国。
entries.en: War is waged to extricate a number of planets from the enemy, forming an independent and friendly Empire.

entries.zh:
发动战争，以强迫敌人成为我们的附庸。

若是通过维持现状结束战争的话，我们所占据的恒星系如果包含至少一个行星则将会被释放为新的附庸。

该附庸的初始协议条款由我们的§Y$policy_subjugation_war_terms$§!政策决定。
entries.en:
War is waged to subjugate the enemy as a Vassal.

In the event of a Status Quo peace, systems we occupy will be released as a new Vassal if they include at least one planet.

Initial Agreement Terms of the Vassal are determined by our §Y$policy_subjugation_war_terms$§! Policy.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以强征敌人为朝贡国。\n\n若是通过维持现状结束战争的话，我们所占据的恒星系如果包含至少一个行星则将会被释放为朝贡国。
entries.en: War is waged to subjugate the enemy as a Tributary.\n\nIn the event of a Status Quo peace, systems we occupy will be released as a new Tributary if they include at least one planet.

entries.zh:
发动战争，以将敌人纳为子公司。

若是通过“维持现状”结束战争的话，我们所占据的恒星系将会被释放为新的子公司，前提是该子公司被释放后必须拥有至少一个行星。

该子公司的初始协议条款由我们的§Y$policy_subjugation_war_terms$§!政策决定。
entries.en:
War is waged to acquire the enemy as a Subsidiary.

In the event of a Status Quo peace, systems we occupy will be released as a new Subsidiary if they include at least one planet.

Initial Agreement Terms of the Subsidiary are determined by our §Y$policy_subjugation_war_terms$§! Policy.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以夺取其分部的控制权。
entries.en: War is waged to seize control of their branch offices.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以动摇敌人的政权及其人民对制度的信心。
entries.en: War is waged to undermine the enemy regime and the populace's faith in their institutions.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以将进攻者的政体和思潮强加给敌人。\n\n若是通过“维持现状”结束战争的话，我们所占据的恒星系如果包含至少一个行星则将会被释放为新的相同意识形态盟友。
entries.en: War is waged to force one's ethos and government form on the enemy.\n\nIn the event of a Status Quo peace, systems we occupy will be released as a new ideological ally if they include at least one planet.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以给崛起者一个下马威。
entries.en: War is waged to teach the upstarts a lesson.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以制止敌人的暴行。
entries.en: War is waged to force the enemy to stop their abominable practices.

entries.zh: 发动战争，将异教徒们驱逐出圣地。
entries.en: War is waged to drive the heathens from sanctified soil.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以净化一切过分接近核心领土的敌人。
entries.en: War is waged to eradicate any enemy presence deemed to be too close to core territories.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以迫使敌人放弃对人工智能天真的利用。
entries.en: War is waged to force the enemy to abandon their naive exploitation of Artificial Intelligences.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以建立统治星系的霸权。
entries.en: War is waged to establish domination over the galaxy.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以让觉醒帝国消灭宇宙文明的共同威胁。
entries.en: War is waged until the Awakened Empire has removed the Galactic Threat.

entries.zh: §Y维持现状§!\n双方都不占据已经有宣称所有权的领土，维持现状的协议会促成§Y无条件和平§!，从而不产生任何边界变更。
entries.en: §YStatus Quo§!\nNeither side currently occupies claimed territory belonging to the other - a status quo settlement now will result in a §YWhite Peace§! without border adjustments.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以消灭宇宙文明的共同威胁。
entries.en: War is waged to end a threat to galactic civilization.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以将敌人从星系中清除干净。
entries.en: War is waged to cleanse the enemy from the face of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以同化目标帝国的人口。
entries.en: War is waged to assimilate the population of the target empire.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以将敌人彻底吸收消化。
entries.en: War is waged to utterly consume the enemy.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以决这个星系鹿死谁手。
entries.en: War is waged to decide who will rule over the galaxy.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以推翻有机压迫者。
entries.en: War is waged to overthrow the organic oppressors.
War is waged to secure independence.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以维护对反叛附属国的统治。
entries.en: War is waged to assert dominance over a rebelling subject.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以袭击和掠夺敌人。该战争目标可以掠夺目标的$r_energy$和$r_minerals$。同时该战争目标也增加我们夺取$relics$的概率。
entries.en: War is waged to raid and plunder the enemy. Using this wargoal will plunder $r_energy$ and $r_minerals$ from the target. Using this wargoal grants us an increased chance to steal $relics$.

entries.zh: 空前强大的武器，可让敌国屈服于我们的意志之下。
entries.en: Immensely powerful weapons allow us to enforce our will upon our enemies.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以消除敌人使用巨像级武器的威胁。
entries.en: War is waged to end a threat of our enemies using their Colossi.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以惩罚攻击星海共同体成员国的帝国。使用这个战争目标可以降低§Y33%§!获得所宣称恒星系时产生的§Y威胁§!。
entries.en: War is waged to punish an empire for attacking a Galactic Community member. Using this wargoal to take claims generates §Y33%§! less §YThreat§! for each conquered system.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以预先彻底消灭对星海共同体的威胁。
entries.en: War is waged to preemptively and completely end a threat to the Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以在一场不公正的、先发制人的战争中保卫我们自身。
entries.en: War is waged to defend ourselves from unjustified preemptive war.

entries.zh: 附庸国臣服于他们的宗主，他们只有有限的外交特权，而且必须与宗主并肩作战。
entries.en: Vassals are subservient to their Overlord. They have limited diplomatic options, and fight along their Overlord.

entries.zh: 保护国受到其宗主的独立保证；在研究宗主拥有的科技时，科研花费减少§Y80%§!；当他们达到宗主§Y50%§!的科技水平时，自动转化为附庸国。
entries.en: Protectorates are guaranteed independence by their Overlord, pay §Y80%§! less for any tech their Overlord knows, and turn into vassals once they reach §Y50%§! of their Overlord's tech level.

entries.zh: 朝贡国是是附属国的一种，他们在绝大多数方面保持独立，但每月需要朝贡§Y25%§!的能量币和矿物收入给宗主国。
entries.en: Tributaries are a type of subject which is mostly independent but pays §Y25%§! of their monthly Energy Credits and Minerals in tribute to their Overlord.

entries.zh: 仆从国是外交独立的附属国，但必须向其宗主国支付§Y25%§!的每月能量币和矿物收入。他们也被禁止扩张至新的恒星系，除了以征服的方式。
entries.en: Thralls are a type of subject which is diplomatically independent but pays §Y25%§! of their monthly Energy Credits and Minerals in tribute to their Overlord. They are also forbidden from expanding into new systems except through conquest.

entries.zh: 神域是附属国，虽然在外交上独立但是其每月将上贡§Y25%§!的能量币和矿物，同时它必须信奉与其宗主相同的思潮。
entries.en: Dominions are a type of subject which is diplomatically independent but pays §Y25%§! of their monthly Energy Credits and Minerals in tribute to their Overlord. They are also forced to take on their Overlord's ethics.

entries.zh: 条约国是外交受限的附属国，受到宗主国的保护，但可以进行扩张。
entries.en: Signatories are a type of subject which is diplomatically subservient to and protected by their Overlord but are permitted to expand.

entries.zh: 卫星国是拥有外交自主权的附庸国，但每月都要向宗主进贡§Y33%§!的物理学、社会学和工程学研究。
entries.en: Satellites are a type of subject which is diplomatically independent but pays §Y33%§! of their monthly Physics, Society and Engineering Research in tribute to their Overlord..

entries.zh: 他们当前研发了其宗主的§Y$RATIO|1$%§!的科技。
entries.en: They have currently researched §Y$RATIO|1$%§! of their Overlords' technologies.

entries.zh: 附属公司是属于附属国的一类，它们受到企业宗主国的支配与保护，但是在外交上可以自由扩张领土与宣战。附属公司必须支付§Y25%§!的每月能量币收入作为贡金。
entries.en: Subsidiaries are a type of subject which is diplomatically subservient to and protected by their Corporate Overlord but are permitted to expand and wage wars among themselves. They also pay §Y25%§! of their monthly Energy Credits in tribute.
